Our teacher let us have a break in the garden. Before we left, I asked, "Could I have some information about the next tour?"

پرسش: درباره آنچه آخر هفته ترجیح می‌دهید انجام دهید ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از would rather، would prefer و had better استفاده کنید.

پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ قوانین مدرسه یا محل کارتان بنویسید. حداقل یک بار از let، make، allow و force استفاده کنید.

پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ قوانین یک مکان عمومی (کتابخانه، پارک، کافه) بنویسید. از mustn't، don't have to و یک question tag استفاده کنید.

پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله یک قانون، یک توصیه و یک حدس بنویسید. از have to، should و must یا can't استفاده کنید.

پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ اشتباهی که کرد‌هاید و کاری که باید می‌کردید بنویسید. از should have و یک حدس با must have یا can't have استفاده کنید.

I do the ___ on Saturdays: I iron and wash the floor.
The ___ in winter are high because the flat is very cold.
The nurse ___ gave me the vaccine was friendly.

Anna, ___ lives upstairs, is a judge.
We don't have ___ money for a new car.

Is this pen yours? No, it is ___.
The man ___ car is outside is my neighbour.
متن را بخوانید و گزینه درست را انتخاب کنید.

My grandmother lives in an old people's home which is near our house. It is a quiet place, and the nurses who work there are very kind. Every Sunday we visit her and bring a few books. She has a small room with a balcony, and she has a walking aid that helps her in the garden. She says the house rules are simple, and she likes her new friends.
When does the family visit her?
What helps her in the garden?
What does she say about the house rules?
پرسش: دربارهی شخصی که می‌شناسید و جایی که او وقت می‌گذراند بنویسید. از who یا which و دستکم دو کمیتنما استفاده کنید.
Write about a person you know and a place where this person spends time. Use who or which, and at least two quantifiers (for example a few, much, a lot of).
133.m: My uncle is a man who loves cooking. He has a small kitchen which is always warm. He doesn't have much space, but he has a lot of good ideas and a few old pots that he uses every day.

s: The pipe ___ in the kitchen needs a plumber.
My ___ and I share the flat and split the rent.
The landlord told us about a rent ___ next month.
I need my health insurance ___ at the doctor's.
I bought ___ for my trip to Spain, so a lost bag is no problem.
We live in a ___: three floors, a garden and neighbours on both sides.
After a long day I was dead ___. I just wanted to sleep.
He ___ the test again and had to repeat it.

متن را بخوانید و گزینه درست را انتخاب کنید.

Last winter we had a problem in our flat: a pipe blockage in the bathroom. My roommate suggested calling the landlord, but he did not answer. We kept trying for two days. Finally a plumber came and finished fixing the pipe in an hour. I enjoyed watching him work, and he told us to avoid putting oil down the sink.
How long did they try to call?
What did the plumber tell them to avoid?
پرسش: دربارهی کاری که در خانه از آن لذت میبرید و کاری که نمی‌توانید تحمل کنید بنویسید. دستکم سه فعل با -ing به کار ببرید.
Write about something you enjoy doing at home and something you can't stand doing. Use at least three verbs followed by -ing (for example enjoy, avoid, keep, finish).
134.m: I enjoy cooking dinner for my roommate. I don't mind washing the dishes, but I can't stand cleaning the bathroom. I always avoid doing it on Sunday, but I finish cleaning it on Monday.

s: I read a funny ___ about cats on the forum.
A ___ is a short video, photo or joke that spreads on the internet.
Send me the ___ to the article and I will read it.

The ___ is the first page of a website.

A ___ stole data from the company's computers.
We can't afford ___ a new laptop.
We plan ___ a podcast next month.
متن را بخوانید و گزینه درست را انتخاب کنید.

My friend Lena decided to start a podcast about everyday life in Turkey. She planned to record one episode a week, but she could not afford to buy a good microphone. She managed to borrow one from a friend. Now she has many followers. She hopes to make a livestream soon, and she promised to answer all questions from the forum.
What did Lena decide to do?
Why did she have a problem?
She could not afford a microphone.
She borrowed one from a friend.
What does she hope to do soon?
پرسش: دربارهی برنامه‌هایتان برای اینترنت یا فناوری امسال بنویسید. دستکم سه فعل با to + مصدر به کار ببرید.
Write about your plans for the internet or technology this year. Use at least three verbs followed by to + infinitive (for example plan, hope, decide, afford).
135.m: This year I plan to start a small blog about my work. I hope to get a hundred followers, but I can't afford to pay for ads. I have decided to write one post every week.

s: The ___ in court listened to both sides and decided the case.
A person who breaks the law is a ___.
It is ___ to drive without a licence.

My ___ is Persian, but I also speak English and Turkish.

متن را بخوانید و گزینه درست را انتخاب کنید.

Yesterday I went to court as an interpreter. The judge asked me to translate for a man who speaks only Pashto. First, the judge told the man to stand, and then she asked him to tell his story. I tried to translate every word carefully. After the case, the judge thanked me and advised me to study law, because she thinks I would be a good lawyer.
Why did the narrator go to court?
Which language does the man speak?
What did the judge tell the man to do first?
What did the judge advise the narrator to do?
پرسش: دربارهی کسی که به شما توصیه می‌کند یا به شما می‌گوید چه کار کنید بنویسید. دستکم سه فعل از این فعل‌ها به کار ببرید: want, ask, tell, advise, expect, allow.
Write about a person who gives you advice or tells you what to do (a teacher, a parent, a boss). Use at least three of these verbs: want, ask, tell, advise, expect, allow.
136.m: My teacher wants us to speak English in class. She often asks us to write short texts, and she advises me to read every day. She doesn't allow us to use our phones.

s: I read the first ___ of the novel yesterday.
Detective stories and ___ novels are my favourite books.
The main ___ in the story is a brave young girl.
My grandmother told me a beautiful ___ about a prince.
I like to relax at the swimming ___ on Sundays.
At the poetry ___, young writers read their own poems.
My ___ was happy: I played in the garden all day.
We spent the afternoon on the ___, lying in the sun.
I stopped ___ because I was tired.
She stopped ___ a cup of coffee.
I remember ___ this book when I was ten.
He tried ___ the poem in one night, but he couldn't.
If you can't sleep, try ___ a book.
We regret ___ you that the event is full.

متن را بخوانید و گزینه درست را انتخاب کنید.

When I was a child, I loved fairy tales. My grandmother always stopped cooking to read me a story. I still remember sitting on the lawn and listening to her. Last month I forgot to buy a gift for her birthday, but I tried to find a book of old stories. I found one in the last shop. She went on reading it for hours, and she smiled.
What did the narrator love as a child?
What did the grandmother stop doing to read?
What did the grandmother do with the new book?
پرسش: دربارهی عادتی که ترک کرد‌هاید یا چیزی از کودکی که به یاد دارید بنویسید. از stop، remember، forget یا try با شکل درست استفاده کنید.
Write about a habit you stopped or a thing you remember from your childhood. Use stop, remember, forget or try with the right form (-ing or to + infinitive).
137.m: I stopped eating sweets last year. I remember buying sweets after school when I was a child. Now I try to eat fruit, and I never forget to drink water.

138.t: فعل با دو شکل و معنی مشابه
s: The ___ truck moved the heavy boxes in the warehouse.
A ___ is a small coin that people keep for good luck.
The bridge is made of ___ and steel.
She wore a soft ___ shirt in the summer.
The statue is made of white ___.
We use ___ to make a barbecue fire.

متن را بخوانید و گزینه درست را انتخاب کنید.

My brother Tom loves cooking, but he hates washing the dishes. He prefers to cook Turkish food rather than Italian food. Last Sunday he started to prepare dinner at four, and he continued cooking for three hours. Afterwards he would like to rest by the pool, but it was starting to rain. So he stayed at home and read a crime novel.
What kind of food does Tom prefer to cook?
Why did he stay at home?
پرسش: دربارهی کار‌هایی که در اوقات فراغت دوست دارید یا ندارید بنویسید. از like، love، hate یا prefer هم با -ing و هم با to + فعل و یک جمله با would like استفاده کنید.
Write about what you like, love, hate or prefer to do in your free time. Use like, love, hate or prefer with -ing and with to + infinitive, and one sentence with would like.
138.m: I love swimming, and I like to go to the pool on Sundays. I hate waiting in queues, so I prefer going early. Next weekend I would like to try a new sport.

139.t: ing-form (gerund) بهعنوان فاعل و بعد از حرف اضافه
s: You can make a wooden board smooth with ___.
A car tyre is made of ___.
We put ___ on the bathroom floor.
A thin metal thread that carries electricity is a ___.
The ___ of the room is three metres from floor to ceiling.
The result when you add numbers and divide by how many there are is the ___.
The theatre was full and the ___ clapped loudly.
___ English every day will help you.
He left the room without ___ goodbye.
I look forward to ___ you next week.
She apologised for ___ the wrong tiles.

He is good at fix things.

He is good in to fixing things.
After ___ the sheet metal, she cleaned her hands.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Tom works in a small workshop. Measuring the length and height of metal sheets is his job. He is good at doing geometry in his head. Before cutting a sheet, he always checks the scale of the plan. Yesterday he apologised for making a mistake with the wire. Now he is looking forward to having a quiet weekend.
What does he check before cutting a sheet?
He made a mistake with the wire
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ شغل یا سرگرمی مورد علاقهتان بنویسید. حداقل سه gerund به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a job or hobby you like. Use at least three gerunds (for example: I enjoy ..., I am good at ..., I look forward to ...).
139.m: I enjoy making small things from wood. I am good at measuring and cutting boards. Before starting a project, I always check the length twice. I look forward to finishing my next table.

s: A small booklet that advertises a product is a ___.
A ___ lists all the products a shop sells.
A story that is not true but looks like real news is ___.
A person who tells actors what to do in a film is a ___.
TV, radio and newspapers together are called the mass ___.
You pay every month for a magazine. This is a ___.
To make a book or article available to the public is to ___ it.
A ___ is a show where people answer questions to win prizes.
My brother is married ___ a nurse.
She is keen on ___ a new language.
This film is different ___ the book.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Maria is a film director. She is famous for her road movies and her TV series. She is very good at telling stories, and she is proud of her team. Last month she was worried about a fake news story about her new film. Now she is interested in making a quiz show. She is tired of working alone and is looking for a partner.
Her road movies and TV series
What was she worried about last month?
A bad review of a book
What is she interested in now?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ خودتان بنویسید. حداقل سه ترکیب صفت + حرف اضافه به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about yourself. Use at least three adjective + preposition combinations (for example: interested in, good at, afraid of, proud of).
140.m: I am interested in photography and I am good at taking photos of people. I am not afraid of speaking in public. I am proud of my small photo studio. I am a little tired of working late every day.

141.t: فعل + حرف اضافه و اسم + حرف اضافه
s: A doctor performs an ___ in a hospital.
A surgeon has to ___ a patient when he is very ill.
To ___ a patient means to give medical care.
Doctors use an ___ to look inside the body.
A person who moves to another country to live there is a ___.
The ___ protects a country on land, on the sea and in the air.
The ___ is the part of the song that repeats.
A ___ is a wind instrument that you blow across.

متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Ali is a young doctor. Last week he performed his first operation. He was nervous, but the nurses were very kind to him. He thanked them for their help. After work he listens to live music and plays the guitar. His brother is a migrant in Germany. Ali is thinking of visiting him next year, but it depends on his work.
What did Ali do last week?
What does Ali play after work?
Why is the visit not sure?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ زمانی بنویسید که منتظر چیزی یا کسی بودید. حداقل سه ترکیب فعل + حرف اضافه به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a time when you waited for something or someone. Use at least three verb + preposition combinations (for example: wait for, depend on, listen to, apologise for).
141.m: Yesterday I waited for my friend at the station for an hour. He apologised for being late. I listened to music while I was waiting. Next time, it will depend on the weather if we meet outside.

142.t: مصدر برای هدف، too و enough
s: Someone who plays the ___ makes music with strings and a bow.
The tune you can sing or hum is the ___.
A large group of musicians who play classical music is an ___.
The beat of a piece of music is its ___.
A metal wind instrument often used in jazz is the ___.
Heavy rain caused a ___ and the water covered the fields.
A wall built across a river to hold back water is a ___.
The farmers had a good ___ this autumn.
She went to the market ___ some fruit.

It ___ important to listen to the melody.
We don't have ___ to buy a saxophone.

It is hard to play the violin.

It hard to play the violin.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last spring, we visited a small village near a brook. We went there to see the blossoms on the fruit trees. The weather was warm enough to sit outside. In the evening, a small orchestra played in the garden. It was a pleasure to listen to the melody. Later it was too dark to walk home along the brook, so we took a taxi.
Why did they go to the village?
An orchestra played in the garden.
Why did they take a taxi?
It was too dark to walk home.
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید چرا کاری (درس، کار، سفر) انجام می‌دهید. برای هدف از to + فعل و یک جمله با too یا enough استفاده کنید.
Write 3-4 sentences about why you do something (study, work, travel). Use to + verb for purpose, and one sentence with too or enough.
142.m: I study English every evening to find a better job. I also listen to music to relax. My English is not good enough to work abroad yet. It is important to practise every day.

143.t: فعل‌های عبارتی جداشدنی و جدا نشدنی
s: Many people visit the ___ to see wild animals and forests.

After the rain there was a big ___ on the road.
In spring, flowers ___ in the garden.

متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last summer, I stayed in a small cabin in a national park. I get on well with the owner, so he showed me the landscape. We took binoculars to watch birds. One day it began to thunder, so we had to call off our walk. In the evening I filled in a form for the park, and I handed it in at the office. I want to go again.
In a hotel in a city
In a cabin in a national park
What did they take to watch birds?
Why did they call off the walk?
What did the writer do with the form?
Handed it in at the office
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ کسی که با او خوب کنار می‌آیید یا برنام‌های که لغو کردید بنویسید. حداقل سه فعل عبارتی به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a person you get on well with or a plan you called off. Use at least three phrasal verbs.
143.m: I get on well with my neighbour. We often look after each other's cats. Last week we planned a trip, but we called it off because of the rain. We will set it up again next month.

144.t: فعل‌های عبارتی سفر، فناوری و سهقسمتی
s: You open a wine bottle with a ___.
A ___ keeps food and drinks cold on a picnic.

You use ___ to stick two pieces of paper together.
You hang your jacket on a ___.

We set off early on Saturday for a camping trip. Before leaving, I checked my bag: there was a hammock, glue, foil, a corkscrew and a cooler bag. After two hours we had run out of petrol, so my brother came up with a plan. He called a friend, who picked us up. We looked forward to a quiet evening, but we couldn't put up with the cold, so we went home.
They couldn't put up with the cold.
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک سفر بنویسید. حداقل سه فعل عبارتی به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a trip. Use at least three phrasal verbs (for example: set off, pick up, run out of, put up with).
144.m: Last weekend we set off for the mountains at seven. My friend picked me up at home. On the way, we ran out of water, but we found a small shop. I look forward to going there again.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.

He is in charge of the project.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

My workshop is in an old building. I usually arrive at 8 o'clock and I am always on time. I am in charge of ten people. During the day we work on the sewing machines. We walk through the garden at lunch. I stay until six in the evening and then I go home by bus.
What time does the writer arrive?
How many people is the writer in charge of?
How does the writer go home?
پرسش: درباره روال روزانه خود ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از at، on، in و یک عبارت ثابت استفاده کنید.
Write 3-4 sentences about your daily routine. Use at, on, in and one fixed phrase (on time, in charge of, in a hurry).
145.m: I get up at 7 o'clock and leave the house at 8. On Mondays I have a meeting in the office. I am always on time because I hate being in a hurry.

146.t: مرور ۶: الگو‌های فعل، حرف اضافهٔ وابسته و افعال عبارتی
s: You blow your nose with a ___.
Which item holds your money and cards in your pocket?

گزینهٔ درست را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.

The printer is on. Please switch ___ before you go.
The boss made us ___ the report again.

We discussed of the new plan.
We discussed on the new plan.
I stopped ___ a coffee, so I was late for the meeting.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Anna works in a small office. She enjoys helping customers, but yesterday the printer had a paper jam and she ran out of staples. She asked her colleague to bring some from the stationery cupboard. After that, she filled in a form and pinned a sticky note on the pinboard. Anna is looking forward to going home at five.
What problem did Anna have with the printer?
What did she run out of?
Who did Anna ask for help?
What is Anna looking forward to?
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ دفتر یا محل کارتان بنویسید. دو الگوی فعل و یک فعل عبارتی به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about your office or workplace. Use two verb patterns (for example enjoy + -ing, decide + to) and one phrasal verb.
146.m: I enjoy working in my small office. Yesterday we ran out of paper, so I decided to order more. I also filled in a form and handed it in to the manager.

147.t: مرور صفت تفضیلی و عالی: much / far / a bit، the most، the least، one of the
s: I am not sure this is true. I ___ it.
A shirt with squares is called ___.

He is one of the nicest people I know.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Lena works as an advisor in a shop. She thinks the checked shirts are far cheaper than the floral ones, but the dotted shirt is the most popular. Customers can pay by invoice, in advance or in installments. Paying in installments is a bit more expensive, but it is the easiest way for many commuters. Lena doubts that online shopping will ever be better.
She is an advisor in a shop.
Which way of paying is a bit more expensive?
What does Lena think about online shopping?
She doubts it will be better.
پرسش: دو چیز آشنا (دو مغازه، دو شغل یا دو شهر) را مقایسه کنید. ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید و از much یا a bit و یک عالی با one of the استفاده کنید.
Compare two things you know (two shops, two jobs or two cities). Write 2-4 sentences. Use much / a bit and one superlative with one of the.
147.m: Tabriz is much colder than Tehran in winter. Shopping in the old bazaar is a bit slower, but it is one of the most interesting places in the city.

148.t: ساختار‌های مقایسه: as ... as، the same as، different from، the more ... the more
s: A person who performs tricks with balls is a ___.
A person who is learning something is a ___.
A person who rents a flat is a ___.
Someone who works without being paid is a ___.
A person who has to leave their country because of danger is a ___.
Mum, dad, aunts and cousins are all your ___.

My sister is as ___ as I am.

More old he gets, the wiser he is.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Tom and his cousin Sara are both volunteers at a language school. Tom is as creative as Sara, but he is not as organized. Their classes are different from each other: Tom teaches speaking, and Sara teaches reading. The more the learners practise, the more confident they become. Everyone loves Sara's friendliness, and Tom's generosity is the same as hers.
Where do Tom and Sara work?
What happens when the learners practise more?
پرسش: خودتان را با یک دوست یا فامیل مقایسه کنید. ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید و از as ... as، the same as یا different from و the more ... the more استفاده کنید.
Compare yourself with a friend or relative. Write 2-4 sentences. Use as ... as, the same as or different from, and the more ... the more.
148.m: My brother is as tall as I am, but his job is different from mine. The more he works, the happier he is. I have the same hobbies as him.

149.t: قید‌ها: ساخت، قید‌های بیقاعده، تفضیلی و عالی قید
s: A person who always tells the truth is ___.
A ___ person does not like changing their mind.
Someone who does not boast about their success is ___.
A ___ person likes meeting people and going to parties.
A yellow flower with seeds that blow away in the wind is a ___.
A plant with spines that grows in the desert is a ___.
گزینهٔ درست را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
The teacher spoke ___ to the caller.
I ___ know him; we have met only once.
She works ___ of all the staff.
They arrived ___ for the meeting, so it had already started.
He quietly closed the window quietly.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Mia is a modest and sincere girl. She loves plants and keeps a small cactus and some moss on her desk. Last week she planned a garden project with her sociable friend Omar. They worked hard and finished early. Omar is not as punctual as Mia, so he arrived late, but he apologised politely. Mia hardly ever gets angry with him.
What plants does Mia keep on her desk?
What did Mia and Omar plan?
How does Mia feel about Omar's late arrival?
She does not talk to him.
پرسش: توصیف کنید یکی از آشنایانتان چگونه صحبت می‌کند، کار می‌کند یا رفتار می‌کند. ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید و حداقل سه قید، از جمله یک تفضیلی، به کار ببرید.
Describe how a person you know speaks, works or behaves. Write 2-4 sentences. Use at least three adverbs, including one comparative.
149.m: My colleague works very hard and speaks politely to everyone. She arrives earlier than the others and always listens carefully.

150.t: قید‌های تکرار، درجه و نگرش: quite، rather، fairly، absolutely، fortunately
s: A person who leads the government of a country is the ___.
A country ruled by a king or queen is a ___.
A group of people with similar political ideas is a political ___.
A public event where people show they disagree is a ___.
A big change in government, often with force, is a ___.
The money you pay to send a letter is called ___.
A red flower often seen in fields is a ___.
If you like tea more than coffee, you ___ tea.
گزینهٔ درست را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
He ___ goes to bed before midnight.
She is ___ on time for work.
The view from the top was ___ wonderful.
We haven't ___ been to the Parliament.
___, nobody was hurt in the protest.
The ticket was ___ expensive, but we bought it anyway.
The film was absolutely a bit brilliant.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Local elections in our town are usually quiet, but this year they were quite exciting. Fortunately, the weather was fine, so many people voted. The new party got a small majority, which was absolutely surprising. The Prime Minister rarely visits small towns, but he sent a letter by air mail. The postage was rather expensive.
What were the elections usually like?
How did the author describe the party's majority?
How did the Prime Minister send his message?
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ عادت‌هایتان یا سیاست در کشورتان بنویسید. یک قید تکرار، یک قید درجه و یک قید نگرش به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about your habits or about politics in your country. Use one frequency adverb, one degree adverb and one attitude adverb.
150.m: I usually read the news in the morning. Local politics is quite interesting. Unfortunately, many people rarely vote in small elections.

151.t: جای قید و قید‌های تمرکز: still، yet، already، even، only، just، ever
s: A person who designs buildings is an ___.
Someone who is learning a job at work is an ___.
A person who cuts men's hair is a ___.
A person who sells meat is a ___.
The ___ is in charge of a ship or plane.
A person who writes music is a ___.
Someone who works for the government is a ___.
گزینهٔ درست را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
She has ___ left the office, so you can't speak to her.
Is he ___ working at the bank?
Have you ___ met a famous architect?
I have ___ spoken to the captain, so I know the news.
___ the apprentice knew the answer, so it was easy.

متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Last week I met a young architect named Karim. He is an apprentice and he has already worked on three buildings. Karim still lives with his parents, but he has just bought a small flat. Apart from his work, he loves music. He has never met a composer, but he often plays the piano. Even his boss says he is very talented.
What is true about Karim and music?
He has never met a composer.
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ شغل یک نفر یا مسیر شغلی خودتان بنویسید. حداقل سه تا از این قید‌ها را به کار ببرید: still, yet, already, just, ever, only, even.
Write 2-4 sentences about a person's job or your own career. Use at least three of these words: still, yet, already, just, ever, only, even.
151.m: I have already worked as an engineer for ten years. I still enjoy my job, but I haven't been promoted yet. Even my boss says I only need more experience.

152.t: صفت‌ها (-ed/-ing)، ترتیب صفت‌ها و صفت به جای اسم
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
The ___ helps passengers on a plane.
A ___ makes pipes and fixes water problems.
A ___ takes pictures with a camera.
A ___ translates speech from one language to another.
The ___ drives a scooter and brings food to homes.
A ___ helps injured people before they reach the hospital.
The lecture was so ___ that I fell asleep.

متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Maria is a photographer. Yesterday she had a long and tiring day. She took pictures of the rich and the poor in the city market. She found a lovely old wooden stall. The owner, a Turkish woman, was very friendly and gave her tea. Maria felt tired but happy.
What kind of stall did she find?
How did Maria feel at the end?
پرسش: درباره شغلی که برایتان جالب یا کسلکننده است ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از صفت‌های -ed و -ing استفاده کنید.
Write 2-4 sentences about a job you find interesting or boring. Use -ed and -ing adjectives.
152.m: I think the job of a journalist is very interesting. Journalists meet surprising people. I am interested in writing, but I would feel tired after long days. The young often like exciting jobs.

s: The person who looks after sheep on a hill is a ___.
A person who makes and repairs clothes is a ___.
There is ___ of food, so everybody can eat more.
He can take ___ five people in his car, not more.
A book with articles about many subjects is an ___.
Something that is ___ is very special in a religion.
My friends and I ___ contacts even after school.
The film was ___ good that I watched it again.
This bag is ___ heavy to carry.
Is the water warm ___ for swimming?
There are ___ cars in the city centre.
They are ___ friendly people that everybody likes them.
She is old enough to vote.
She is enough old to vote.
She is old too to vote.
She is so old to vote.
He ran ___ fast that nobody could catch him.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Anna is a tailor in a small town. She has such a busy life that she has almost no free time. Her shop is too small for all her customers, so she wants a bigger one. A real estate agent is helping her. Yesterday they saw a shop that was big enough, but the rent was too high. At most she can pay 800 euros, so she will keep looking.
Why does she want a new shop?
What was wrong with the shop she saw yesterday?
How much can Anna pay at most?
پرسش: دو تا سه جمله درباره مکانی که می‌شناسید بنویسید. از too و enough استفاده کنید.
Write 2-3 sentences about a place you know. Use too and enough.
153.m: My flat is too small for a big family. It is not big enough for guests, but the location is good enough for me.

s: A person who leads a Protestant church is a ___.
Muslims go to a ___ to pray.
You use a ___ to put out a small fire.
A place where scientists do experiments is a ___.
A ___ is a very old animal or plant preserved in stone.
A ___ is a group of billions of stars.
A school where children stay until the afternoon, with lunch and lessons, is an ___ school.
A meeting where parents talk to teachers is called a ___.
___ the pastor live near the church?
Could you tell me where the lab ___?
Do you know what time the service ___?
Don't you like physics? - ___. I love it.
I wonder ___ he knows the answer.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Last week our school had a parents' evening. Many parents asked the teachers about the science lessons. One father asked, "Could you tell me when the students visit the laboratory?" The teacher answered that they go there every Friday. A mother wanted to know who teaches physics. The teacher said, "Mr Weber teaches it. Don't you know him?"
What event did the school have?
What did the father want to know?
When do the students go to the lab?
پرسش: دو تا سه سؤال بنویسید که می‌خواهید از یک معلم بپرسید. یک سؤال غیرمستقیم هم استفاده کنید.
Write 2-3 questions you want to ask a teacher. Use one indirect question.
154.m: Who teaches chemistry? Does the school have a laboratory? Could you tell me when the next parents' evening is?

s: A ___ is a small shop that sells newspapers and snacks.
A ___ is a reduction in price.
An outdoor market for second-hand goods is a ___ market.
If a product is ___, the shop has no more of it.
Shopping on the internet is ___ shopping.
A scientist uses a ___ to see very small things.
You use your sense of ___ to notice a perfume.
The person who invites guests to a party is the ___.

A: I love shopping online. B: ___.
A: I can't find the voucher. B: ___.
Did you buy a ticket? Yes, ___.
A: I went to the garden party. B: ___?
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Tom and Lisa went to a flea market on Saturday. It wasn't very big, was it? No, but they found many interesting things. Lisa bought an old lamp at a nice discount. Tom said, "I didn't want anything, but I like this old book." The seller asked, "You like books, don't you?" Tom answered, "Yes, I do. And so does Lisa."
Where did Tom and Lisa go?
What did Tom answer when the seller asked about books?
Yes, he and Lisa like books.
پرسش: دو جمله با question tag درباره یک مغازه یا بازار بنویسید.
Write two sentences with question tags about a shop or market.
155.m: The market is nice, isn't it? You don't sell old books, do you?

s: A ___ is a member of a country with legal rights.

To show ___ means to treat people kindly and politely.
A ___ takes people and things into space.
An ___ is a sound that comes back after you shout in the mountains.

It was cheap, though it broke quickly, but.
Though it was cheap, but it broke.

Despite it was cheap, it broke.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Our neighbourhood is small. However, it has a strong community. Although many inhabitants are busy, they do voluntary work at the youth center. Despite the cold weather, forty citizens came to the housewarming party of our new neighbour. Some people brought food, whereas others brought music. Everybody showed respect and had a great evening.
Small but with a strong community
Where do many inhabitants do voluntary work?
What event did forty citizens come to?
پرسش: دو جمله درباره محلهتان بنویسید. از although و however استفاده کنید.
Write two sentences about your neighbourhood. Use although and however.
156.m: Although my neighbourhood is noisy, I like it. The streets are old. However, the people are friendly.

s: A ___ is a game played with sticks and a ball on ice or grass.

He came early in order to help.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Last Saturday there was a go-kart race in our town. Many people came because the weather was nice. Tom wanted to win, so he trained all week. He also bought a new helmet so that he could drive safely. Because of a small problem with his kart, he came only third. As a result, he got bronze. Tom was happy anyway because it was his first race.
Why did Tom train all week?
Why did he come only third?
He had a problem with his kart.
پرسش: دو جمله درباره ورزشی که دوست دارید بنویسید. از because و so استفاده کنید.

157.m: I like swimming because it is good for my back. I swim every week, so I feel fit.

158.t: آزمون روز linker :۹۰های افزودن، ترتیب و مثال
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.

Here is how to make a backup. Firstly, open the folder with your files. Then, copy them to a hard drive. In addition, you can save the files in the cloud. Finally, check that the copy works. Many programs, for instance, a browser, can make a backup automatically.
Where can you copy the files?
پرسش: درباره شروع کار با کامپیوتر یا گوشی ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از firstly، then و finally استفاده کنید.
Write 2-4 sentences about how to start a computer or phone. Use firstly, then and finally.
158.m: Firstly, press the power button. Then, enter your password. In addition, check your internet connection. Finally, open the browser.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.

The ___ makes sound louder so many people can hear.

A ___ shows a picture or video on your desk.

Our office has a new system. It is faster than the old one and easier to use. Firstly, you open the folder with your files. Then, you click on the label. In addition, the system makes a backup automatically. The young staff like it very much, but some older people are not interested yet.
How is the new system compared with the old one?
What does the system do automatically?
Who likes the system very much?
پرسش: دو وسیله را که استفاده می‌کنید ۲ تا ۴ جمله مقایسه کنید. از comparative و linker استفاده کنید.

159.m: My laptop is faster than my phone. However, my phone is lighter. In addition, it is easier to carry. I think the laptop is the best for work.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
A ___ connects your computer to the internet at home.

متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last week there was a problem in our office. There was no network connection, and the router did not work. It took two hours to find the reason. There seemed to be a security error on the server. Finally, the supervisor restarted the system. Now it works well, and there is a new update for the software.
How long did it take to find the reason?
What was wrong at the beginning?
پرسش: درباره اتاق یا دفتر خود ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از there is/are و it استفاده کنید.
Write 2-4 sentences about your room or office. Use there is/are and it.
160.m: There is a big desk and a laptop in my office. There are two windows, and it is always bright. It takes ten minutes to get to my office from home.

The ___ checks the work of the employees.
I want the newest ___ of the program.

He ___ work hard, but he often forgets things.
What I need ___ a quiet room.
It was Tom ___ broke the printer.

It on Monday was that we met.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Yesterday I had a very bad morning. I did turn on my laptop, but it was so slow that I could not log in. What I needed was a quick update. It was the old version that caused the problem. After one hour, I did download the new version, and then everything worked. It was such a relief!

How did the writer feel at the end?
پرسش: درباره مشکل یک دستگاه ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از did/does برای تأکید یا What ... is استفاده کنید.
Write 2-4 sentences about a problem with a device. Use did/does for emphasis or What ... is.
161.m: My phone is so old that it is always slow. I did try to update it, but it crashed. What I need is a new phone. It was my brother who gave me this one.

Last month my friend and I planned a trip. We had plenty of ideas, but neither of us could decide on a place. We thought about it for several days. In the end, we chose a small town. It is close enough to reach in a couple of hours by train. The deadline for booking is next Friday, so we will book as soon as possible.
How long did they think about the place?
How long is the train trip?
When is the deadline for booking?
پرسش: درباره برنامه آخر هفته خود ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از enough، several، plenty of یا a couple of استفاده کنید.
Write 2-4 sentences about your plans for the weekend. Use enough, several, plenty of, or a couple of.
162.m: I have plenty of free time this weekend. I want to visit a couple of friends and read several chapters of my book. I don't have enough money for a trip, so I will stay at home.

My family likes to travel. We go on holiday twice a year. In summer, we go either to the sea or to the mountains. In winter, we sometimes stay at home. Nowadays my parents are not only busy but also tired, so we plan our trips in advance. This year, both my sister and I want to visit Istanbul.
How often does the family go on holiday?
Where do they go in summer?
To the sea or to the mountains
Why do they plan trips in advance?
The parents are busy and tired.
پرسش: درباره اوقات فراغت خود ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از both ... and، either ... or یا neither ... nor استفاده کنید.
Write 2-4 sentences about your free time. Use both ... and, either ... or, or neither ... nor.
163.m: In my leisure time, I both read and listen to music. At weekends I either go for a walk or meet friends. I neither watch TV nor play video games.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.

متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

The village has about 2,000 people. The main road is five kilometers long. It is a country road with a speed limit of 50 km/h. Every morning, around 30 percent of the people go to the town by bus. Half of them work in a factory, and a quarter work in shops. The village market is on Saturdays.
How many people live in the village?
How long is the main road?
پرسش: درباره شهر یا روستای خود ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از عدد، کسر یا درصد استفاده کنید.
Write 2-4 sentences about your city or village. Use numbers, a fraction or a percentage.
164.m: My city has about 500,000 people. Half of them use public transport every day. The main road is ten kilometers long, and the speed limit is 60 km/h.

165.t: نشانه‌های گفتمان در مکالمه (well، actually، anyway، by the way، to be honest)
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
Show your ticket at the ___ counter before the flight.
Wait at the ___ until the boarding time.
The ___ is the place where you collect your suitcase after landing.
A trip for work is a ___.
Ships stay in the ___ when they are not at sea.
In the train, there are six seats in each ___.
A ___ gives you a lower price if you book early.
July and August are the ___ in many countries.
A: Do you like the hotel? B: ___, the room is nice, but it is noisy.
The flight is at six, not five. ___, I made a mistake in my first message.
___, did you buy the train tickets?
It is late. ___, I have to go now.
___, I don't like long flights. They are tiring.
I ___ work in a travel agency. (now)
Which marker is best for adding a new side topic?
Which word shows hesitation at the start of an answer?
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Anna and Tom are at the airport. Anna says, "Well, I think our gate is closed." Tom checks the board. "Actually, it is open," he says. "The flight leaves at nine." Anna laughs. "To be honest, I was nervous. By the way, did you get the baggage tags?" Tom nods. "Yes. Anyway, let's go to the gate."
What is true about the gate?
What does Tom suggest at the end?
پرسش: درباره یک سفر ۲ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. حداقل دو نشانهٔ گفتمان به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about a trip. Use at least two discourse markers.
165.m: Well, my last trip was to Istanbul. To be honest, the flight was long, but the hotel was great. By the way, the harbor there is beautiful. Anyway, I want to go again.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
Before the holiday, I made a hotel ___ online.
A ___ is a person who travels in a train, bus or plane.
A trip that includes flight, hotel and meals is a ___.
The ___ is the way from one place to another.
During my stay abroad, I lived with a ___.
A ___ flight is short, for example from Istanbul to Ankara.
Put your bag on the ___ above your seat.
Ships stop at the ___ to take on passengers.
___ you tell me the way to the pier, please?
Would you mind ___ me your passport number?
Which sentence is the most formal?
I would like to make a reservation.
Which is a natural informal ending?
I look forward to hearing from you.
In a formal letter, "I can't come" becomes:
I am afraid I cannot come.
Which word is more formal than "get"?
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to enquire about a room in your hotel for two nights in July. We would like a room with a view of the harbor. Could you tell me the price, please? I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, Maria Lopez.
To ask about a hotel room
For how long does she want the room?
Why does she use Yours faithfully?
She does not know the name
پرسش: یک ایمیل رسمی کوتاه (۲ تا ۴ جمله) به یک هتل برای پرسیدن درباره رزرو بنویسید.
Write a short formal email (2-4 sentences) to a hotel to ask about a booking.
166.m: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to enquire about my hotel booking. Could you confirm the date, please? I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, Reza Eskandari

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
I stayed in a cheap youth ___ in Berlin.
Istanbul is a huge ___ with millions of people.
A ___ is a very fast car used in competitions.
In the desert, a strong ___ made it hard to see.
Flights, hotels and food are part of the ___.
When people travel to another country, they ___.
The air is wet and heavy today; the ___ is very high.
I bought a travel guide. ___ has maps and photos.
Anna and Tom came late. ___ missed the tour.
The hostel was cheap; ___, it was not very clean.
My sister who lives abroad, is a pilot.
My sister, who lives abroad is a pilot.
My sister, who lives abroad, is a pilot.
My sister who, lives abroad is a pilot.
I need three things for the trip___ a bag, a map and a ticket.
The flight was late___ we missed our train.
I have two bags. ___ is old and the other is new.
Which linking phrase shows a contrast?
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last summer, my friend Lena went abroad for the first time. She stayed in a youth hostel in a big metropolis, and she visited many places with a tour. The travel expenses were high; however, she saved money by using a scooter. She says the trip was great. It taught her to plan carefully, and she wants to go again next year.
In the sentence 'It taught her to plan carefully', what does 'It' refer to?
پرسش: دربارهٔ یک سفر ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. حداقل دو کلمهٔ ربط و یک نقطهویرگول به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a trip. Use at least two linking words and one semicolon.
167.m: Last year I went abroad with my family. We stayed in a youth hostel; it was cheap and clean. First, we visited the marketplace. Then we took a tour of the metropolis. However, the travel expenses were higher than we expected.

168.t: اصلاح خطا ۱: زمان‌ها، حروف تعریف و حروف اضافه
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
She works in a ___ center and answers customer questions by phone.
My ___ shows my education and work experience.
Every employee has four weeks of ___ vacation.
The ___ head decides who works on each project.
If you have a problem, call the ___ person, Ms Lee.
Scientists from many countries came to the ___ in Istanbul.
My career ___ started in a small shop and led to a management job.
An ___ is a person who works for a company and gets a salary.
I ___ my CV to the employer last week.
My sister wants to become ___ electrician.
I am not good ___ writing emails.
When we arrived, the meeting ___ already started.
He depends ___ his boss for the schedule.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Karim works in a call center. He has been an employee there for two years, and he is interested in a better career path. Yesterday, he talked to his department head about promotion. She gave him some advice and told him to update his CV. Now he is writing a new CV, and he hopes to have an interview next week.
How long has Karim worked in the call center?
Who did he talk to yesterday?
What did she tell him to do?
پرسش: دربارهٔ شغل یا تحصیل خود ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. since یا for، یک حرف تعریف و یک حرف اضافه بعد از صفت به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about your job or studies. Use since or for, one article, and one preposition after an adjective.
168.m: I am a software developer. I have worked for a small company since 2019. I am interested in learning new skills, and I am good at solving problems. Yesterday I talked to my manager about my career.

169.t: اصلاح خطا ۲: افعال وجهی، شرطی، مجهول و گفتار غیرمستقیم
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
Before you start a new job, you must sign the employment ___.
A ___ works for many clients and has no single boss.
With ___ working hours, you can start at 7 or at 10.
Today I work from my ___ because my child is sick.
The manager asked her many questions in the job ___.
Please send your application to the ___ department.
In ___ work, students solve tasks together.
You ___ smoke in the office; it is against the rules.
If I ___ more money, I would buy a car.
She told ___ that the meeting was cancelled.
If you ___ the form yesterday, you wouldn't have a problem now.
We will have the picnic tomorrow ___ it rains.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last week, Sara had a job interview in the HR department. The HR manager asked her if she could work flexible hours. Sara said that she would prefer a home office two days a week. The manager told her that this was possible if the team agreed. The employer will send the employment contract tomorrow.
Who asked Sara about flexible hours?
A home office two days a week
When was the home office possible?
What will the employer send tomorrow?
پرسش: دربارهٔ یک مصاحبهٔ شغلی ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. یک جملهٔ شرطی، یک مجهول و یک گفتار غیرمستقیم به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a job interview. Use one conditional, one passive and one reported-speech sentence.
169.m: I had a job interview yesterday. The manager asked me why I wanted the job. I said that I enjoyed group work. If I get the job, I will start next month. The employment contract will be sent to me by email.

170.t: تمرین ترکیبی B1 (جای خالی، تبدیل جمله، چندگزین‌های)
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
A person who looks for work is a job ___.
The ___ is the name of your position, for example Manager.
We meet in the ___ at ten o'clock.
She writes down everything in the ___ of the meeting.
A ___ is a small job with low pay.
He works at night; this is the ___.
A ___ position will not end after a few months.
When people stop working at an older age, it is called ___.
If the machine breaks, we ___ call the mechanic.
He told ___ that he was tired.
The report ___ by the clerk yesterday.
It is ___ cold to work outside.
She said she ___ call me later.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Ali works as a logistics assistant in a big warehouse. He has worked there since 2020 and he has a permanent position. His shift starts at six in the morning. Every Monday there is a short meeting in the meeting room. Ali is interested in a better job, so he is learning English in the evening. He hopes to get a promotion soon.
What kind of position does he have?
پرسش: درباره شغل خود یا شغلی که دوست دارید ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از since یا for و یک جملهٔ شرطی استفاده کنید.
Write 3-4 sentences about your job or a job you would like. Use since or for, and one conditional sentence.
170.m: I have worked as a software engineer for ten years. If I get a promotion, I will work more with a team. I am interested in learning new things. I enjoy working with customers.

171.t: تمرین ترکیبی خواندن و نوشتن B1
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
When you want a job, you ___ for it.
The ___ is the day when you begin working.
In your email, mention your ___ for pay.
Workers in a factory wear ___ to protect their feet.
He wants to ___ professionally and become a manager.
A ___ job lasts only for a short time.
The company will ___ the contract for one more year.
She works from eight to five; she works ___.
I am writing ___ apply for the job.
She has worked here ___ two years.
I look forward to ___ from you.
If I get the job, I ___ work hard.
It is a good job. ___, the pay is low.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

The company Green Foods is looking for a kitchen assistant. The job is full-time, and the work starts at seven in the morning. The company offers a permanent contract and a good salary. Workers need to work well in a team and wear safety shoes. People who want to apply must send an email by the end of the month.
What job is the company offering?
پرسش: یک ایمیل کوتاه (۳ تا ۴ جمله) برای درخواست شغل بنویسید. از I am writing to... و I look forward to... استفاده کنید.
Write a short email (3-4 sentences) applying for a job. Use I am writing to... and I look forward to...
171.m: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the job of kitchen assistant. I have worked in a restaurant for two years and I work well in a team. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, Reza Eskandari

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
The union protects the rights of ___.
Money paid to a person without a job is ___ benefit.
Many employees now work ___: only four hours a day.
Good ___ means friendly colleagues and a pleasant place.
A ___ is a person who works with their hands in a factory.
People get their ___ at the end of the month.
A warehouse ___ moves and stores goods.
If I ___ more time, I would learn Italian.
The letter ___ by the manager yesterday.
___, I don't like the night shift. It is tiring.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last year, Sara decided to change her job. She had worked as a clerk for ten years, but she wanted something more interesting. She applied for a position in the personnel office of a large company. The interview was easy, and she got the job. Now she works full-time and enjoys helping staff. If she works hard, she will get a promotion next year.
How long had Sara worked as a clerk?
پرسش: درباره برنامه‌های کاری یا تحصیلی خود ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید. از یک جملهٔ شرطی و یک linker استفاده کنید.
Write 3-4 sentences about your plans for work or study. Use a conditional sentence and a linker.
172.m: I have worked in software for many years. If I finish my studies, I will find a better position. In addition, I would like to learn new skills. Finally, I hope to start my own company.

s: The tea is only ___, so I will heat it again.
We found a ___ beach where nobody else was around.
After a long discussion, the two sides finally reached a ___.
After moving abroad, it took her months to ___ the new culture.
Many citizens ___ for better public transport.
The old bridge may ___ if it is not repaired soon.
Please ___ your idea, because it is not clear to us.
She wore a bright red coat to ___ attention.
When I got home, my sister ___ dinner.
By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.
I'll tell you the news as soon as I ___ home.
He ___ the answer, so he stayed silent.
Don't phone at nine; we ___ dinner at that time.
When I was young, I ___ play in the street every evening.
Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last summer, Mia found a secluded cottage by the sea. At first the water was only lukewarm, but she loved the quiet. She had been working very hard before that, so she spent hours daydreaming on the beach. By the time she went home, she had decided to change her job and to collaborate with a small team that she respected.
It was in the city centre.
It was quiet and far from other people.
How was the water at first?
What did Mia do on the beach?
What had she decided by the time she went home?
پرسش: ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ جایی بنویسید که قبلاً در آن زندگی می‌کردید و اینکه زندگیتان چطور تغییر کرده است. از used to، گذشتهٔ کامل و حال کامل استفاده کنید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a place where you lived in the past and how your life there has changed. Use used to, the past perfect and the present perfect.
173.m: I used to live in a small village near Tabriz. By the time I left, I had spent twenty years there. Since I moved to the city, I have been working in an office, and I have made many new friends.

174.t: مرور پل: مدال‌ها، شرطی‌ها، مجهول، گفتار نقل‌شده و موصولی‌ها
s: Many people ___ two hours every day to reach the city centre.
Customs officers can ___ illegal goods at the border.
After a long argument, both sides had to ___.
Which verb means 'to say that something is not true'?
The company must ___ that all workers are safe.
Chemical waste may ___ the fish in the river.
The police will ___ the new law next month.
The suspect ___ the crime; he was abroad that week.
If she ___ harder, she would have passed the test.
The rules ___ strictly in this school.
He told me that he ___ the next day.
The woman ___ daughter won the prize is my neighbour.
She asked me what I wanted.
She asked me what did I want.
She asked to me what I wanted.
She asked me that what I wanted.
If we ___ more staff, we could finish earlier.
The camp, ___ is near the lake, was closed last year.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Mark has to commute two hours every day. Last week he began to doze on the train and missed his stop. His boss would not compromise about the working hours, so Mark decided to confront him. If the company had been more flexible, Mark would not be so tired now.
How long does Mark commute every day?
He missed his stop after dozing
He was late because of a strike
Why did Mark decide to confront his boss?
The boss refused to compromise about the hours
Mark's boss agreed to change the hours
Mark would be less tired if the company had been more flexible
پرسش: ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک قانون در مدرسه یا محل کارتان بنویسید. یک جملهٔ مجهول و یک جملهٔ شرطی نوع دوم به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a rule at your school or workplace. Use one passive sentence and one second conditional sentence.
174.m: Phones are not allowed in our office during meetings. The rule is enforced by the manager. If we could use phones, we would be distracted. I think the rule is fair.

s: The company wants to ___ its business into Asia.
Soldiers began to ___ the city when the army approached.
Our teacher will ___ our projects next week.
The shop promised to ___ a full refund.
Heavy snow can ___ traffic and cause delays.
She had to ___ when the microphone stopped working.
Wind turbines ___ electricity from moving air.
When we arrived at the station, the train ___.
While I ___ the report, my boss came in.
She was exhausted because she ___ all day.
After he ___ the contract, he went home.
It ___ heavily when the guards left their posts.
I had known her for years before we met again.
I was knowing her for years before we met again.
I have known her for years before we met again.
I knowing her for years before we met again.
By the time the police came, the thieves ___.
How long ___ when the manager arrived?
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last winter, Lena was walking home when she noticed that her bag was open. She had left the office in a hurry and had forgotten to zip it. Her wallet was gone! She had been carrying it all day, so she guessed it had fallen out on the bus. She called the company and, luckily, someone had found it.
What was Lena doing when she noticed the problem?
She had forgotten to zip it
Where did Lena think she had lost the wallet?
پرسش: یک داستان کوتاه (۳ تا ۴ جمله) دربارهٔ روزی که اتفاقی غیرمنتظره افتاد بنویسید. گذشتهٔ ساده، استمراری و کامل را به کار ببرید.
Tell a short story (3-4 sentences) about a day when something unexpected happened. Use past simple, past continuous and past perfect.
175.m: I was waiting for the bus when I realised I had left my keys at home. I had been looking forward to a quiet evening, so I was annoyed. I called my brother, and he brought the spare keys an hour later.

176.t: حال کامل ساده در برابر استمراری
s: Money worries ___ many young families today.
Scientists want to ___ that the new method works.
The teacher always ___ on silence during tests.
A good leader can ___ a team to do its best.
The company hopes to ___ waste in the factory.
Which verb means 'to become very good at something'?
Police used a phone signal to ___ the missing child.
She is out of breath. She ___.
I ___ five emails this morning, and I'm not finished.
He is living in Ankara since 2015.
He has live in Ankara since 2015.
He has lived in Ankara since 2015.
How many cups of coffee ___ today?
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Sara has been working as a nurse for six years. This month she has been helping at a new clinic near the border. She has already treated over two hundred patients, and she has been learning a lot about how to handle emergencies. She hasn't had a holiday since last summer, but she loves her job.
How long has Sara been a nurse?
Where has she been helping this month?
How many patients has she treated so far?
She hasn't had a holiday since last summer.
پرسش: ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ کاری که اخیراً انجام می‌دهید و چیزی که امسال به آن رسید‌هاید بنویسید.
Write 3-4 sentences about something you have been doing recently and something you have already achieved this year.
176.m: I have been learning English for two years. Recently I have been practising every evening. This year I have passed two exams and I have read three novels. I haven't finished my project yet.

s: The government promised to ___ the old tax system.
Doctors say it takes weeks to ___ after the operation.
The shop agreed to ___ the money because the phone was faulty.
Angry crowds began to ___ in the capital.
The old church was carefully ___ after the war.
The company will ___ the new film next month.
He had no choice but to ___ violence.
When I got to the station, the train ___.
If she ___ the warning, she would not have lost her money.
I wish I ___ so much last night.
No sooner ___ the door than the alarm rang.
She was tired because she ___ since five o'clock.
Hardly ___ the room when the lights went out.
If only I would have listened to my teacher!
If only I listen to my teacher!
If only I have listened to my teacher!
If only I had listened to my teacher!
He said that he ___ the report the day before.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Tom was furious when he came home. Someone had broken into his flat while he had been working abroad for three months. The thieves had taken his laptop, but they hadn't touched his old books. If he had installed an alarm, they would not have entered so easily. He wished he had listened to his neighbour, who had warned him.
Someone had broken into his flat
What had Tom been doing for three months?
What did the thieves not touch?
That he had sold the flat
That he had listened to his neighbour
That he had bought a laptop
پرسش: ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ تصمیمی که از آن پشیمانید بنویسید. یک جملهٔ شرطی نوع سوم و I wish + past perfect به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a decision you regret. Use a third conditional sentence and I wish + past perfect.
177.m: Last year I didn't apply for a scholarship because I thought I wasn't qualified. If I had applied, I might have studied abroad. I wish I had been braver. Now I always try everything.

178.t: آیندهٔ کامل استمراری و آینده در گذشته
s: The new law could ___ small businesses.
Prices began to ___ after the announcement.
I can't ___ this noise any longer.
The view from the top of the mountain was ___.
It is ___ to carry water when walking in the desert.
The speech was so ___ that everyone agreed.
A small mistake can ___ a serious crisis.
By next July, she ___ in this company for ten years.
By the time we ___, the shop will have closed.
He said that he ___ me the following day.
I ___ leave when the phone rang.
We ___ buy a house, but prices went up.
At midnight they ___ for twelve hours.
By Friday I will finishing the project.
By Friday I finished the project will.
By Friday I will have been finished the project.
By Friday I will have finished the project.
Little did she know that she ___ the prize.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Next Monday, Nina will have been working at the museum for exactly three years. When she started, she thought she would stay only for a few months. She was going to leave last year, but the director offered her a better position. By December she will have saved enough money to travel, and she is already planning her trip.
How long will Nina have worked at the museum next Monday?
What did she think when she started?
She would stay for a few months
Why didn't she leave last year?
The director offered her a better job
What will she have done by December?
پرسش: ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ برنامه‌هایتان برای پنج سال دیگر بنویسید. آیندهٔ کامل استمراری و یک جمله با was going to به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about your plans for five years from now. Use future perfect continuous and one sentence with was going to.
178.m: In five years, I will have been working as an engineer for three years. By then I will have saved enough money for a flat. I was going to study abroad, but I changed my mind.

s: The manager gave us some ___ feedback that helped us improve.
The ___ method is slow, but it works.
The instructions were ___, so nobody was confused.
A ___ machine broke down after one day.
The ambassador gave a ___ answer so as not to offend anyone.
This sofa is ___ and lasts for many years.
It was a ___ victory that changed the whole season.
The prime minister ___ visit Canada next week.
She is ___ be late; she always is.
He was on the point of ___ when the phone rang.
This time tomorrow we ___ on a beach.
The new model ___ go on sale in March.
I was about to call you.
I was about to calling you.
I about to call you was.
Prices are ___ rise again next year.
___ you be using the car tonight? I need to go shopping.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

The mayor is to open the new community centre on Saturday. The centre, which is set to become the heart of the neighbourhood, offers courses for adults and a library for children. Local residents are bound to enjoy it. Next Saturday at noon, the mayor will be cutting the ribbon, and the choir will be singing.
Who is to open the new centre?
Courses for adults and a library for children
What is the centre set to become?
What will the mayor be doing on Saturday at noon?
پرسش: ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک رویداد آینده (واقعی یا خیالی) با be to، be set to و be bound to بنویسید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a future event (real or imaginary) using be to, be set to and be bound to.
179.m: The new library is to open next week. It is set to become the biggest in the city. Students are bound to love the quiet reading rooms.

s: She is known for her ___ nature; she always pays for everyone's dinner.
The comedian was so ___ that the whole room laughed.
