Wearing a tie to work is the ___ in this firm.
Lack of money was the main ___ to the project.
From a child's ___, the problem looks different.
The government set a ___ for imported goods.
The army ordered a ___ from the city.
As a ___, add the salt after the water boils.
The rule needs ___ by the committee.
I would love ___ the show last night.
The company is said ___ a lot of money last year.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Many people think that success depends on luck, but this is a myth. In my experience, hard work is the main factor. When I started my business, I felt pleased to have received a small loan, yet the biggest obstacle was my own fear. I do not regret having taken the risk. Nowadays I am proud of being known for honest service.
What does the writer call a myth?
What is he proud of now?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله درباره یک موفقیت و یک اشتباه در گذشتهتان بنویسید. از having done و to have done استفاده کنید.
Write 3-4 sentences about an achievement and a mistake in your past. Use having done and to have done.
211.m: I am proud of having finished my degree while working. I would like to have started learning English earlier. I regret having wasted time, but I seem to have learned from my mistakes.

212.t: الگو‌های فعل + مفعول و افعال حسی
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
A ___ energy source does not run out or damage the environment.
A new problem may ___ if the two teams do not communicate.
High prices may ___ many tourists from visiting the island.
Engineers had to ___ the cost before the project began.
She tried to ___ her mistake by working extra hours.
Please do not ___ the plan; we agreed on every detail.
Before choosing a university, you should ___ the pros and cons.
What does 'to be at someone's mercy' mean?
to be completely under someone's control
I heard the phone ___ twice, but I did not answer.
My boss made me ___ the report again.
She was seen ___ the building at midnight.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Last year our city launched a sustainable transport plan. At first, the mayor tried to persuade people to leave their cars at home, but many drivers were at odds with the idea. Then the council estimated the costs and decided to build more bike lanes. Now you can see hundreds of cyclists crossing the bridge every morning. The plan has not weakened the economy; it has actually made it stronger.
What did the mayor try to do first?
Persuade people to leave their cars at home
Estimate the cost of the bridge
What did the council do after estimating the costs?
Decided to build more bike lanes
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله درباره زمانی بنویسید که کسی به شما توصیه کرد یا شما را متقاعد کرد کاری انجام دهید. حداقل دو فعل از این درس را به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a time when someone advised or persuaded you to do something. Use at least two verbs from this lesson.
212.m: Last spring my brother advised me to apply for a job abroad. At first I was torn, but he persuaded me to try. I saw him smiling when I got the interview, and he made me promise to call him afterwards.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
The nurse stressed the ___ of the situation: the patient needed help at once.
The doctor treated the ___ pain with strong medicine.
Please check the ___ of your passport before you travel.
The train was late. ___, we missed the first meeting.
He loves city life, ___ his wife prefers the countryside.
The flight was delayed, but ___ this, we arrived on time for the party.
The hotel is cheap and clean. ___, it is close to the station.
The doctor said the infection was caused by a ___.
The manager is responsible ___ the budget.
Please don't blame me ___ the delay.
There is a growing demand ___ electric cars.
We arrived ___ the airport at six.
The new road is a threat ___ the local wildlife.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Dr Karimi works at a clinic in a small province. Last week an unscheduled visit changed her day: a patient came in with acute pain. She asked about the symptoms and learned that he suffers from a rare disease. She was familiar with it, so she was able to act quickly. The man thanked her for the urgency of her help. Moreover, he congratulated her on her skill.
She did not know the disease
She was familiar with the disease
What did the patient do at the end?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله درباره یک مشکل در شهر یا کشور خود بنویسید. حداقل سه حرف اضافه وابسته مانند a threat to، responsible for و depend on به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a problem in your city or country. Use at least three dependent prepositions, for example a threat to, responsible for, depend on.
213.m: Air pollution is a serious threat to public health in my city. Traffic is mostly responsible for it. The solution depends on better public transport, and many people are insisting on changing the rules.

214.t: حروف اضافه زمان، مکان و حرکت
s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
Doctors found serious ___ after the accident: part of the man's brain no longer worked.
Scientists warned that the ___ could spread quickly through the region.
Measles is highly ___, so sick children should stay at home.
Early ___ of cancer greatly improves the chances of recovery.
Good blood ___ is important for a healthy heart.
A person with ___ often forgets names and places.
After a long period of stress at work, she suffered from ___ syndrome.
The doctor made a clear ___ after the tests.
The new clinic will open ___ July.
___ the event of a power cut, the generators start automatically.
His opinion is at odds ___ that of his colleagues.
You must finish the exam ___ noon; after that nobody can enter.
The hospital is ___ the river and the railway station.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Last winter an epidemic spread across our region. During those weeks, the emergency doctor worked from 7 am until midnight. She was in charge of a team of nurses and a geriatric nurse helped elderly patients. In the event of serious symptoms, patients were taken through a special entrance to the ward. Thanks to early detection, nobody was at risk of brain damage, and the hospital was calm by March.
An epidemic spread in the region
How long did the emergency doctor work each day?
What happened in the event of serious symptoms?
Patients were taken through a special entrance
When was the hospital calm again?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله یک روز عادی هفته خود را توصیف کنید. حروف اضافه زمان، مکان و حرکت را درست به کار ببرید.
Describe your usual weekday in 3-4 sentences. Use prepositions of time, place and movement correctly.
214.m: On weekdays I get up at 6.30 and walk along the river to the station. I work in an office on the third floor, and I am in charge of the customer service team. I usually finish by 5 pm and go home through the park.

s: A document from a doctor that confirms you are healthy is a ___.
Our body's defence against infections is the ___.
A ___ helps women during pregnancy and delivers babies.
A ___ is a doctor who treats children.
After her knee operation she needs ___ to strengthen her muscles.
Patients in a very serious condition are treated in the ___.
An infection of the lungs is called ___.
The Black Death was a deadly ___ in the Middle Ages.
We are looking forward ___ you soon.
I can't ___ this noise any longer.
The match was ___ because of the rain.
The ambulance ___ on the way to the hospital.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Last month my grandmother caught pneumonia. She was taken to the intensive care unit, where the nurses looked after her day and night. The doctors ruled out a tumor with an MRI. After two weeks she got over the worst of it and started physiotherapy. Now we are looking forward to taking her home, but she must cut down on salt.
What did the doctors rule out?
What did she begin after two weeks?
What must she cut down on?
پرسش: ۲ تا ۳ جمله دربارهٔ زمانی بنویسید که بیمار بودید یا از بیماری مراقبت کردید. دستکم دو فعل عبارتی به کار ببرید.
Write 2-3 sentences about a time when you were ill or looked after someone who was ill. Use at least two phrasal verbs.
215.m: Last winter I came down with pneumonia. My sister looked after me and I got over it after three weeks. I am looking forward to being completely well again.

s: When stress causes real pain without a physical reason, the illness is ___.
Food poisoning from eggs or chicken is often caused by ___.
After the accident he was ___ and did not respond to anyone.
The scan showed a ___ in her brain, so she needed an operation.
A sore throat with swollen glands at the back of the mouth may be ___.
Eating too many sweets can lead to ___.
The ___ divided the city of Berlin from 1961 to 1989.
The long political conflict between the USA and the Soviet Union is called the ___.
She ___ her boss because he always helped her.
Could you hand ___ your report by Monday?
She was sad, so we tried to ___.
We get on very well ___ our neighbours.
The rash finally ___ after a week of treatment.
Which formal verb means the same as 'put off'?
They ___ last year, and she is now with someone else.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Mark took on too much work last year. He never turned down a project, and he bottled up his stress. One morning he passed out in the office and was taken to hospital. The doctor said that his problems were psychosomatic. Now Mark has stepped down as team leader, and a colleague has taken over. He is getting over it slowly with the help of psychotherapy.
He fell out with a friend.
He took on too much work.
He broke up with a friend.
He passed out in the office.
What did the doctor say about his problems?
Who has taken over Mark's job as team leader?
پرسش: یک رابطهٔ دوستی یا موقعیت کاری از زندگی خودتان را شرح دهید. دستکم سه فعل عبارتی از درس به کار ببرید (۲ تا ۴ جمله).
Describe a friendship or a work situation from your life. Use at least three phrasal verbs from the lesson (2-4 sentences).
216.m: I get on very well with my colleagues. Last year I took on a new project and I never let my team down. When we had an argument, we made up quickly, and now we look forward to the next challenge.

s: The ___ was a US programme that helped rebuild Europe after the Second World War.
A ___ is a building or monument that reminds people of important events or victims.
The ___ is the rent without heating, water and other extra charges.
In Germany, ___ include heating, water and rubbish collection.
A law that limits how much a landlord may charge is a ___.
A person who wants to rent a flat but has not signed a contract yet is a ___.
Talking about someone ___ is unfair, because they cannot defend themselves.
Paying a deposit is ___ when you rent a flat.
The professor ___ a lecture on the Cold War.
We could not drive because of the ___ rain.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Anna is a prospective tenant. She applied for a flat in Berlin and discussed the cold rent with the landlord. The landlord insisted on a deposit and warned her that the ancillary costs depend on the heating. Anna made a decision quickly, because rents are rising and she did not want to take a risk. She is now looking forward to signing the lease.
What did the landlord insist on?
What do the ancillary costs depend on?
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک تصمیم مهم بنویسید. دستکم سه همنشینی با make, take, have, do یا give به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about an important decision you made. Use at least three collocations with make, take, have, do or give.
217.m: Last year I made a decision to study abroad. I had a long discussion with my family and took a big risk. I did a lot of research before I applied for a place.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
The news of his resignation came ___ and surprised everyone.
Although she earned a lot, she felt like a bird in a ___.
I cannot ___ this noise any longer; I'm going to complain.
I'm ___ between the two job offers and cannot decide.
A ___ insurance pays when you accidentally damage someone else's property.
The manager gave the team ___ to choose their own methods.
Online ___ can seriously harm teenagers' mental health.
Parents can ___ their children's choices without forcing them.
I suggest that he ___ a doctor.
It is vital that the report ___ sent today.
The court demanded that she ___ the company immediately.
He talks as if he ___ the best player in the team (he isn't).
They insisted that he ___ the form.
She looked as though she ___ the news already.
Is it necessary that every student ___ present?
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Last week our manager invited all staff to a meeting. He insisted that everyone be present, and he suggested that we discuss the new insurance rules. It was essential that each department send a report, he said. Suddenly, out of the blue, he announced a new rule: nobody may work from home on Fridays. He spoke as if the decision were final. Many colleagues felt torn, but nobody wanted an argument.
What did the manager insist on?
What announcement came out of the blue?
No working from home on Fridays
How did he speak about the decision?
As if it was a joke
As if it had been cancelled
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله به دوستی که کار جدیدی شروع می‌کند توصیه کنید. حداقل دو مورد از suggest that، it is essential that، insist that و as if را به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences giving advice to a friend who is starting a new job. Use at least two of these: suggest that, it is essential that, insist that, as if.
218.m: I suggest that you arrive early on your first day. It is essential that you learn your colleagues' names quickly. My boss always insisted that new staff ask questions, so do not behave as if you knew everything.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
Because of the ___, he only sees news that agrees with his opinions.
Following good ___ means being polite in online messages.
A fake email asking for your bank password is called ___.
She grew up speaking two languages, so she is ___.
'Fruit' is an ___ for apples, oranges and bananas.
The company took ___ for the data leak and apologised.
He took a taxi ___ be on time.
She spoke quietly ___ the baby would not wake.
It was ___ a hot day that we stayed inside.
The coffee was ___ hot that I couldn't drink it.
He is ___ young to drive a car.
She isn't ___ to run the marathon.
There were ___ people that we couldn't find a seat.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Many people use an online platform to share their opinions, but a filter bubble can be so strong that they never see different views. To avoid this, experts advise users to follow different sources. Good netiquette is also important, because a rude comment is too easy to write and too hard to delete. One teacher is bilingual and she teaches students how to define terms clearly so that they can discuss ideas without conflict.
What can a filter bubble do?
Why do experts advise users to follow different sources?
What is said about rude comments?
They are easy to write and hard to delete
Why does the teacher teach students to define terms?
So that they can write faster
So that they can discuss ideas without conflict
So that they can avoid exams
So that they can learn German
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید چرا مردم از شبکه‌های اجتماعی استفاده می‌کنند. یک ساختار هدف (to / in order to / so that) و یک ساختار نتیجه (so ... that / such ... that) به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about why people use social media. Use one purpose structure (to / in order to / so that) and one result structure (so ... that / such ... that).
219.m: People use social media to keep in touch with friends. It is so easy to use that even children can post photos. Some users read the news there in order to save time. However, it is such a powerful tool that we must use it carefully.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
The tenant went to court after the landlord ended the ___ without reason.
You must give three months' ___ before leaving the flat.
The family hired a lawyer to start a ___ against the company.
Under the contract, who is ___ for the damage?
The ___ listened to the evidence and reached a verdict.
He wants to ___ his father's house after he dies.
A person under 18 is a ___ in law.
The company agreed to ___ the farmers for the damage.
The police suspected him of ___ the money.
The judge recommended that he ___ the fine.
My lawyer advised me ___ before signing.
Please hand ___ the documents by Friday.
The tenant is liable ___ any damage to the flat.
The case was too complicated ___ in one day.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

Last month a tenant started a lawsuit against his landlord. The landlord had ended the lease agreement without notice, and the tenant demanded that the court compensate him. His lawyer advised him to collect all documents. The jury listened carefully, and in the end the judge ruled that the landlord was liable for the damage. The tenant was so relieved that he thanked everyone, including the opposing lawyer.
Why did the tenant start a lawsuit?
The landlord ended the lease without notice
How did the tenant feel at the end?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله درباره یک مشکل حقوقی (مثلاً اختلاف اجاره) بنویسید و بگویید چه توصی‌های می‌کنید. حداقل سه ساختار از این مرور را به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a legal problem (for example a rental dispute) and what you would advise. Use at least three structures from this review.
220.m: A tenant was accused of damaging a flat, but he denied causing the problem. I would advise him to collect evidence so that he can defend himself. It is essential that he hire a lawyer, and he should look forward to a fair trial.

s: بهترین گزینه را برای جای خالی یا معنی انتخاب کنید.
The author finished the ___ and sent it to the publisher.
The museum is looking for someone to ___ the new exhibition.
It takes years to ___ a second language fluently.
The publisher decided to ___ a famous writer to produce a short novella.
The ___ of the circle is twenty centimetres.
Bronze is an ___ of copper and tin.
The farm covers fifty ___ of land.
The company can end the contract ___, with no warning.
My sister works as ___ nurse in ___ hospital.
___ education is important for ___ future of every child.
She plays ___ violin but she doesn't play ___ tennis.
We went to ___ church last Sunday to pray.
He is ___ best writer in our editorial office.
I read a book and a magazine. ___ book was more interesting.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤالات پاسخ دهید.

An author received a letter from a publishing house. They wanted to commission a novella about the spirit of adventure. The author had only one manuscript, so he decided to acquire new ideas. He read literature from many countries and visited a university library. The editorial office supervised the work, and after three months the book was ready. The broadcasting corporation later made a programme about it.
What did the publishing house want?
Why did the author read literature from many countries?
What did the broadcasting corporation do?
Made a programme about the book
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله درباره کتاب یا فیلم مورد علاقهتان بنویسید. به a/an، the و حالت بدون حرف تعریف دقت کنید.
Write 3-4 sentences about your favourite book or film. Be careful with a/an, the and zero article.
221.m: My favourite book is a novella about a young sailor. The author wrote it in the 19th century, and literature students still study it. I read it every summer because it gives me a spirit of adventure.

s: A ___ is a long-lasting illness that does not go away quickly.
The amount of medicine you must take is the ___.
A patient who visits the hospital but does not stay overnight is an ___.
A ___ helps readers because it is easy to understand and pleasant to read.
When a pill has an effect only because the patient believes in it, this is the ___.
To ___ means to identify an illness after an examination.
The leaflet inside a medicine box is the ___.
A reader who writes to a newspaper to share an opinion sends a ___.
There is ___ sugar left, so we cannot bake the cake.
___ patients came, so the doctor could start the meeting.
A number of patients ___ waiting in the corridor.
The number of outpatients ___ increased this year.
___ student in the class has a different topic.
We waited the ___ afternoon for the results.
Most of ___ doctors in this hospital are young.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Dr Moreau runs a small clinic. A number of outpatients visit every day, and the majority of them have chronic problems. Each patient receives a different dosage, and the doctor always explains the package insert. There is little time, but she tries to answer every question. Few doctors give so much attention to their patients.
What kind of problems do most outpatients have?
How much time does she have?
What does the writer say about other doctors?
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک مراجعه به پزشک یا کلینیک بنویسید. دستکم سه سور مانند few، a little، a number of، the majority of، each یا every به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about a visit to a doctor or a clinic. Use at least three quantifiers such as few, a little, a number of, the majority of, each or every.
222.m: Last week I visited a clinic. A number of patients were waiting, but the majority of them were only there for a check-up. Each person saw the doctor for a few minutes, and I had a little time to ask about my dosage.

223.t: اسم‌های شمارا و ناشمارا و هماهنگی
s: A large mass of ice that moves slowly down a mountain is a ___.
A very strong storm with powerful winds is a ___.
Something that encourages you to do something, such as a bonus, is an ___.
A young person between childhood and adulthood is an ___.
People of the same age or status are your ___.
A person who cannot read or write is ___.
The study of music as an academic subject is ___.
A long time without rain is a ___.
Can you give me some ___ about the course?
The police ___ looking for the missing boy.
Economics ___ one of the most popular subjects.
The news about the hurricane ___ shocking.
Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the problem.
Ten minutes ___ not enough to finish the test.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

After the hurricane, a migrant family lost all their belongings. The government offered an incentive for volunteers, and a group of adolescents collected clothes and furniture. The staff of the local office are giving advice and information to anyone who needs help. The news about the project is good: more help is coming next week.
What did the migrant family lose?
What are the staff of the office giving?
What is the news about the project?
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک بلای طبیعی یا خانواد‌های که به کمک نیاز داشت بنویسید. دستکم سه مورد از information، advice، belongings، the police، news و a pair of را به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about a natural disaster or a family that needed help. Use at least three of these: information, advice, belongings, the police, news, a pair of.
223.m: Last year a hurricane hit our town. The police were quick to help, and the news was on television all day. Many families lost their belongings, so volunteers gave them clothes, advice and a lot of useful information.

s: A person who always wants everything to be perfect is a ___.
A person who takes over a job from someone else is a ___.
Someone who thinks only about himself is ___.
A person who thinks about other people's feelings is ___.
Someone who can recover quickly from difficulties is ___.
A person who acts on their own initiative is ___.
A person who answers the questions of a survey is a ___.
Someone who refuses to accept other opinions shows ___.
The children enjoyed ___ at the party.
The two sisters often help ___ with their homework.
I like the blue jacket more than the black ___.
Everyone has to bring ___ own laptop.
Will it rain tomorrow? I hope ___.
Is there anything interesting on TV? No, there is ___.
I'm looking for ___ to help me with the report.
He asked her to wait, and she ___ so.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Mia is a conscientious and open-minded manager. She never blames herself for small things, but she always asks her team to help each other. Everyone in her office knows that she is approachable. Last week a respondent from the survey wrote that nobody in the company is arrogant. Mia thinks so too, and she hopes the successor will continue this culture.
What kind of manager is Mia?
What does Mia ask her team to do?
Nobody in the company is arrogant.
The successor will continue the culture.
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ فردی که تحسینش می‌کنید بنویسید. دستکم سه مورد از himself/herself، each other، one/ones، everyone، nobody و so/not را به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about a person you admire. Use at least three of these: himself/herself, each other, one/ones, everyone, nobody, so/not.
224.m: My teacher is a person I really admire. She taught herself three languages, and everyone in the school respects her. Her students always help each other, and nobody is afraid to ask questions. Is she perfect? I think so.

s: A system of ideas and beliefs, especially in politics, is an ___.
Something that seems real but is not is an ___.
A unit used to measure the loudness of sound is a ___.
The force that pulls objects towards each other is ___.
A place where nuclear energy is produced is a ___.
Dishonest or illegal behaviour by powerful people is ___.
A group of ministers who help the government lead the country is the ___.
An agreement between parties to form a government together is a ___.
Choose the correct order: She wore a ___ dress.
The data ___ last year show a clear trend.
She is the first woman ___ the prize.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

The new coalition has presented a five-year plan to fight corruption. The cabinet says that the old political system is the main problem. A small group of citizens, waiting outside the parliament, supports the idea. Many people hope for a fair and honest government, but others fear that this is only another illusion.
How long is the coalition's plan?
What does the cabinet say is the main problem?
Where is the small group of citizens?
That it is only an illusion
That the plan is too long
پرسش: یک شیء یا مکان را با یک گروه اسمی بلند توصیف کنید که دستکم دو صفت به ترتیب درست و یک اسم مرکب داشته باشد.
Describe an object or a place using a long noun phrase with at least two adjectives in the correct order and one compound noun.
225.m: I live near a beautiful old swimming pool that was built in the nineteenth century. It has a long blue tile wall, and every summer a three-week festival takes place there.

s: The ___ is the directly elected body of the EU where deputies meet.
The right to say what you think openly is ___.
The belief that war and violence are wrong is ___.
The politician in charge of a country's money is the ___.
The group of parties that criticises the government is the ___.
A person who makes laws is a ___.
The ___ is an international agreement about climate protection.
A country with great political and military power is a ___.
The end ___ the debate was dramatic.
He raised ___ hand and asked a question.
We stayed at my ___ for the weekend.

The party lost ___ influence after the election.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

The Lord Mayor of a small town is a friend of mine. Yesterday's meeting of the municipal council was about freedom of speech and human dignity. The mayor raised his hand and asked for silence. The opposition's leader criticised the party's decision, but the legislators' vote showed a clear majority for the mayor's plan.
Who is a friend of the writer?
A majority for the mayor's plan
پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک جلسه یا رویداد بنویسید. یک بار 's یا s'، یک بار ساختار of و یک بار a friend of mine (یا حالت اضافهٔ مضاعف دیگر) به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about a meeting or an event. Use 's or s' once, an of-phrase once, and a friend of mine (or another double genitive).
226.m: Yesterday's meeting of the council was long. A friend of mine, who works in the mayor's office, told me about the decision. The people's opinion was clear, and I raised my hand to agree.

s: A change in the law or system to make it better is a ___.
A punishment, for example by cutting trade, against a country is a ___.
A large public meeting to support something is a ___.
The ability to recover from difficulties is ___.
A person who sells houses or arranges deals for others is a ___.
A person who teaches at a university is a ___.
To like one thing more than another is to ___.
This phone is ___ better than my old one.
The ___ you practise, the better you speak.
Their flat is twice ___ as ours.

He works ___ an accountant in Berlin. (this is his job)

This is ___ the best restaurant in the city.

متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

Last year the state parliament passed a reform. The more people discussed it, the more rallies there were. This year's rally was three times as large as the first one, and it was by far the biggest protest action in the history of the state. A lecturer from the university said that the organisers worked like professionals.
What did the state parliament pass?
How large was this year's rally?
Three times as large as the first
What did the lecturer say about the organisers?
What happened as people discussed the reform?
پرسش: در ۲ تا ۴ جمله دو شهر، دو شغل یا دو ایده را مقایسه کنید. یک تفضیلی با قید، ساختار the more ... the more (یا مشابه) و twice as ... as (یا by far) به کار ببرید.
Compare two cities, jobs or ideas in 2-4 sentences. Use a modifier with a comparative, the more ... the more (or similar), and twice as ... as (or by far).
227.m: Istanbul is far bigger than Tabriz, and it is twice as crowded. The more time I spend there, the more I enjoy it. It is by far the most exciting city I know.

s: A person who is grateful and shows thanks is ___.
Something such as petrol that catches fire very easily is a ___ material.
Material that can blow up is ___ material.
A poisonous chemical is a ___ substance.
The way people use to leave a building safely in an emergency is the ___.
Equipment that protects your ears from noise is ___.
The scientific study of language is ___.
The process in which something grows back or is renewed is ___.
The lecture was so ___ that I fell asleep.
I was ___ by the results of the experiment.
The baby is ___ now, so please be quiet.
She is a ___ lecturer in linguistics.
متن را بخوانید و گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید.

The research institution showed a new emergency blanket and a fire blanket at the safety fair. The visitors were fascinated by the small, well-designed equipment. One engineer explained that the escape route was absolutely clear in every test. The demonstration was extremely interesting, and many people left feeling confident and relaxed.
An emergency blanket and a fire blanket
A hearing protection and a microscope
What did the engineer say about the escape route?
پرسش: روزی را توصیف کنید که خسته یا هیجانزده بودید. دستکم سه قید تعدیلکننده (مانند extremely، absolutely، really) و یک جفت -ed/-ing یا یک صفت مرکب به کار ببرید.
Describe a day when you felt tired or excited. Use at least three modifying adverbs (such as extremely, absolutely, really) and one -ed/-ing pair or a compound adjective.
228.m: Last Monday was an extremely tiring day. The meeting was really boring, and I was absolutely exhausted when I got home. However, I had a well-paid job offer, which was exciting, so I felt excited at the end.

229.t: قید‌ها: جای قید، قید‌های تمرکزی، درجه و نظر
s: Treating people unfairly because of their race or age is called ___.
A group that is much smaller than the rest of the population is a ___.
The rules of polite behaviour in a society are called ___.
The school promotes equal ___ for all students.
Repeated unwanted behaviour that upsets someone is ___.
A ___ society includes people from many cultures.
Many ___ families cannot afford school books.
The ___ organization sent food and water after the flood.
گزینهٔ درست را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
My neighbour ___ complains about the noise.
It was ___ impossible to find a seat.
I was so tired that I could ___ keep my eyes open.
___, the grant was refused, and the club had to close.
I didn't plan a big party. I ___ wanted a quiet evening.
She works ___ for the aid organization.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Maya works for an aid organization that supports disadvantaged families. She always listens carefully to people who face discrimination or exclusion. Last week she organised a multicultural evening at the integration club. Surprisingly, almost two hundred guests came. Everyone was friendly, and the event was absolutely wonderful. Maya only wishes that equal opportunities were available to all young people.
What did Maya organise last week?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله بنویسید یک باشگاه چگونه می‌تواند به اقلیت‌ها کمک کند احساس شمول کنند. دستکم سه قید به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about how a club can help people from a minority feel included. Use at least three adverbs (for example always, only, fortunately).
229.m: A club can always welcome new members warmly. Fortunately, many clubs now offer equal opportunities to everyone. They should only choose activities that all members can enjoy. Absolutely nobody should feel excluded.

s: A set of clear steps for solving a problem is called an ___.
In an ___, two versions of a web page are compared to see which works better.
Software uses an ___ to communicate with another program.
___ makes objects layer by layer from a digital model.
In ___, personal data is changed so that nobody can identify the person.
An ___ is a list of items stored under one name in a program.
___ is a flexible way of working in short cycles.
___ is a sport where you walk, swim and abseil down a river canyon.
گزینهٔ درست را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
When the API ___ ready, we will test it.
___ the test was short, it gave useful results.
Hardly had we left the office ___ the server crashed.
While ___ the report, he found an error.
We used a token ___ nobody could access the data.
Not only ___ the new design faster, but it is also cheaper.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Our team is building a new app that uses AI. Last week we ran an A/B test with two versions of the screen. Although the first version looked nicer, the second one performed better. Because the API was slow, we changed the architecture. Hardly had we finished when users started sending positive feedback.
What did the team run last week?
Why did the team change the architecture?
What happened right after they finished?
پرسش: پروژه‌ای را که روی آن کار کرده‌اید توصیف کنید. یک بند قیدی (because, although یا when) و یک جمله با ترتیب درست حالت، مکان و زمان به کار ببرید.
Describe a project you worked on. Use one adverbial clause (because, although or when) and one sentence with manner, place and time in the correct order.
230.m: Last year I worked on a small app. Although the architecture was simple, the algorithm was difficult. We tested it carefully in the office on Friday. When the API was ready, we released the app.

231.t: اعداد، تاریخ، اندازهگیری و کسر‌ها؛ either، neither، both، several، enough
s: A ___ is a point in a process that slows everything down.
The ___ of a network is how much data it can carry per second.
A ___ stores frequently used data so that it can be reached quickly.
___ checks that a user really is who they say they are.
___ decides what a verified user is allowed to do.
A security ___ happens when attackers get unauthorized access.
Using machines or software to do tasks without people is called ___.
The ___ is the part of a system that runs on the server, behind the screen.
گزینهٔ درست را برای جای خالی یا سؤال انتخاب کنید.
Three ___ of the data is clean.
The cache is not big ___ to store all the files.
I tried two passwords, but ___ of them worked.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Our company stores big data on a backup server. Last Monday, 15 June, a breach affected about a third of the files. Authentication was weak, and the bandwidth was too small to stop the attack quickly. Several managers met the next day. Neither of the two plans was perfect, but both were useful. Now there is enough budget for a new system.
Where does the company store big data?
What part of the files was affected?
Why could the company not stop the attack quickly?
What is said about the two plans?
Neither was perfect, but both were useful.
پرسش: اتاق یا دفتر کار خود را در ۳ تا ۴ جمله توصیف کنید. دستکم دو اندازه و یکی از both, either, neither را به کار ببرید.
Describe your office or room in 3-4 sentences. Use at least two measurements and one of: both, either, neither.
231.m: My office is five metres long and four metres wide. It has two windows, and both of them face the street. Neither window is very big, but there is enough light. I have several books on a two-metre shelf.

232.t: مرور ۵: دستور زبان و لغات فناوری
s: A ___ is a group of computers or servers that work together.
The ___ checks whether the code is correct before it is added to the project.
A ___ automatically stops the flow of electricity when there is a fault.
The ___ translates source code into a program the computer can run.
Making files smaller so they use less space is called ___.
The CISO is responsible for ___ in the company.
When two systems work together without problems, we talk about their ___.
We have ___ time, so we cannot finish the review today.
This chipset is ___ than the previous one.
Neither of the engineers ___ the answer.
He ___ complained about the slow cloud server, so nobody knew about the problem.
The more we test, ___ bugs we find.
The manager ___ called the meeting is the new CIO.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last year our company moved all its data to a cloud server. The CDO says the new system is much faster than the old one, and the engineers are very happy with it. Few users complained, and every problem was solved quickly. Next week, both engineers will review the code together, because the team wants a safer and more reliable system.
What did the company do last year?
It moved its data to a cloud server
It hired a new CTO only
How does the CDO describe the new system?
Much faster than the old one
More expensive than the old one
Who will review the code next week?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دو ابزار یا سیستم را مقایسه کنید. حداقل یک صفت تفضیلی، یک کمیتنما و یک قید به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences comparing two tools or systems you know. Use at least one comparative, one quantifier (few, little, many or much) and one adverb.
232.m: Our new cloud server is much faster than the old one. It also has fewer errors, and little time is wasted during backups. However, it is not as cheap as the previous system. Overall, the engineers work more efficiently now.

s: A ___ packages an application with everything it needs to run.
The set of choices that decide how a system works is its ___.
Too much traffic that slows a network is called ___.
A ___ is a value that does not change in a program.
___ protects information by turning it into secret code.
An attack carried out over the internet is a ___.
A ___ is a short team meeting held every day in agile work.
The ___ of data means how correct it is.
___ the server was updated, it still crashed.
___ the congestion, the website loaded quickly.
The old system was slow; ___, it was very stable.
Our CTO likes containers, ___ our CIO prefers physical servers.
___ hard they worked, they could not meet the deadline.
In spite of ___ the whole night, he failed the audit.
She is very clever. ___, she makes careless mistakes.
Despite of the fact that it was old, it worked.
Despite the fact that it was old, it worked.
Despite it was old, it worked.
Although it was old, but it worked.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Our company suffered a serious cyberattack last month. Although the attackers entered the console, they could not reach the main data. Despite the stress, the team stayed calm and followed the plan. The CTO wanted to close the system, whereas the CISO preferred to keep it open and watch the traffic. Nevertheless, they agreed on one thing: a full data audit was necessary.
What happened to the company last month?
It moved to a new office
What did the attackers fail to do?
What did the leaders agree on?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک مشکل فنی بنویسید. although، despite و however (یا nevertheless) را درست به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a technical problem you or a team had. Use although, despite and however (or nevertheless) correctly.
233.m: Although the new configuration looked correct, the system crashed twice. Despite the long testing period, we missed one important error. However, the team fixed it quickly. Nevertheless, we need a better review process.

s: A copy of data kept in case the original is lost is a data ___.
When unauthorised people get access to private data, it is a data ___.
Data ___ means the files have been damaged or changed by mistake.
Making data unreadable to others by using a code is data ___.
Getting lost files back after a failure is data ___.
Finding and removing errors in a program is called ___.
A ___ is a collection of organised information stored on a computer.
A system whose parts run on many separate computers is ___.
The match was cancelled ___ the bad weather.
We did not stop the update ___ it would cause no harm.
The server crashed; ___, users could not log in.
You may enter the data room ___ you have a digital signature.
Back up the files now; ___, you may lose them.
It was ___ a serious breach that the CEO resigned.
Take a spare disk ___ the first one fails.
___ the backup works, we will not lose any data.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last week a data leak affected our company. The problem was due to a damaged disk, so some files were lost. Fortunately, the team had a backup, thereby avoiding a bigger loss. The manager said everyone must use encryption from now on, otherwise the same problem could happen again. The recovery was so successful that customers noticed nothing.
What must everyone use from now on?
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک مشکل دادهٔ فرضی و راهحل آن بنویسید. because of، consequently و provided that (یا as long as) را به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a data problem and how it was solved. Use because of, consequently and provided that (or as long as).
234.m: Because of a faulty disk, we lost some data last week. Consequently, the service stopped for two hours. We restored everything from the backup. The system will stay safe provided that we test the backups regularly.

s: A ___ is a security system that controls network traffic.
The ___ is the part of a website that users see and use.
A ___ translates a domain name into an IP address.
___ means that a system is not working for a period of time.
A ___ is an unmanned flying machine.
Written instructions for software are called ___.
Ethical hacking means testing systems ___ to find weaknesses.
Docker is fast. ___, it is easy to learn.
___ the firewall, we use a VPN.
___, open the file system. Then, check the extension.
The project had many problems. ___, it was a success.
___, I did not like Docker, but now I use it every day.
In addition to ___ the data, we encrypt it.
___, I forgot to tell you: the FTP server is down.
In conclusion the, framework saves time.
In conclusion, the framework saves time.
In conclusion saves time the framework.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Our team follows three steps when we deploy a new service. First of all, we write the documentation. Next, we test the endpoint on a small server. Finally, we move it to production. In addition to this, we always watch the downtime. Overall, the process is slow, but we make fewer mistakes. By the way, we use Docker for every project.
Where do they test the endpoint?
What does the writer say about the process overall?
It is slow, but they make fewer mistakes
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله توضیح دهید چگونه یک ابزار یا سرویس را راهاندازی کردید. first of all، then، in addition و in conclusion (یا overall) را به کار ببرید.
Describe how you set up a tool or service in 3-4 sentences. Use first of all, then, in addition and in conclusion (or overall).
235.m: First of all, I installed Docker on the server. Then I configured the endpoint and tested it. In addition, I wrote short documentation for the team. Overall, the setup was simple and reliable.

236.t: وارونگی بعد از قید‌های منفی (Never, Rarely, Hardly ... when, Not only ... but also)
s: The delay before data starts to transfer is called ___.
A sensor in a phone that measures rotation and orientation is a ___.
When an AI model gives confident but false information, this is called a ___.
A program that repeats forever because it never stops is stuck in an ___.
Sharing incoming traffic between several servers is called ___.
Data ___ means that information stays accurate and has not been changed illegally.
A robot built to look and move like a person is a ___.
Using a trained model to make a prediction on new data is called ___.
Hardly had the server restarted ___ the latency dropped.
No sooner had we deployed the patch ___ the system crashed.
Not only ___ hallucinate, but it also ignored the user's prompt.
Only after the test was complete ___ the results.
Rarely ___ this interface in their projects.
Seldom does he check the logs.
Seldom does he checks the logs.
Seldom he does check the logs.
At no point during the outage ___ the integrity of the data in danger.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last night the team noticed that latency was very high. Hardly had they restarted the server when the speed improved. Not only did the load balancing start working again, but the GPU also ran faster. At no time was the integrity of the data in danger. Only after the restart could the engineers see the real cause: an infinite loop in an old library.
What did the engineers notice first?
Why did the team restart the server?
What does the writer say about the integrity of the data?
It was lost for an hour.
It was changed by the model.
پرسش: یک مشکل فنی که داشت‌هاید را توصیف کنید و دو ساختار وارونه به کار ببرید.
Describe a technical problem you once had. Use two inversion structures, for example 'Never have I ...' and 'No sooner had ... than ...'. (2-4 sentences)
236.m: Never have I seen a server fail so quickly. No sooner had we updated the library than the latency increased. Only after we checked the logs did we find the cause.

237.t: تأکید و جمله‌های cleft (It-clauses, Wh-clauses, do/did برای تأکید)
s: A file that records events in a system is a ___.
Adapting software to a specific language and culture is called ___.
Software designed to damage or steal data is ___.
A bug where a program keeps using memory and never releases it is a ___.
Data about other data, such as the date a photo was taken, is ___.
To combine changes from two branches of code is to ___.
Software whose source code anyone can read and change is ___.
An AI system inspired by the brain, with connected layers, is a ___.
___ I need is a faster processor.
It was the memory leak ___ caused the crash.
What the team wants ___ to merge the code today.
I ___ like the new interface, but it is too slow.
It was in 2020 ___ the company released the first module.
What surprised everyone ___ how quickly the log grew.
It is the operator who ___ the final decision.
It is the next sprint what we need to plan.
What it is the next sprint we need to plan.
It is the next sprint that we need to plan.
It the next sprint that we need to plan.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last week our app kept crashing. It was a memory leak that caused the problem. It was a young engineer who found it in the log. What the team needs now is better monitoring. We did replace the old microservice last week, but the new module still uses too much memory. All we want is a stable system.
What caused the problem in the system?
What does the team need now?
When did the team replace the old microservice?
پرسش: دربارهٔ یک مشکل در کار یا پروژه بنویسید و یک it-cleft، یک what-clause و یک do/did تأکیدی به کار ببرید.
Write about a problem at work or in a project. Use one it-cleft, one what-clause and one emphatic did/does. (2-4 sentences)
237.m: It was a bug in the log module that stopped our work. What we need is a quick fix. We did test the code twice, but the error remained.

238.t: حذف و جایگزینی برای جلوگیری از تکرار (so, not, do so, one/ones، پاسخ کوتاه)
s: A small update that fixes a specific problem in software is a ___.
Making a program faster or more efficient is called ___.
A series of connected steps where one output becomes the next input is a ___.

A unique identifier for each row in a database table is a ___.
Running several tasks at the same time is called ___.

A model that has already been trained on large data before fine-tuning is ___.
Do you use the old port or the new ___?
Will the update fail? — I hope ___.
I can't fix the port, but Anna ___.
I don't like the new interface, and ___ does my manager.
We upgraded the processor, and ___ did they.
He wanted to optimize the code, but he didn't have time ___.
Is the test going to pass? — I don't think ___.
I wanted to deploy the patch, but my manager told me don't.
I wanted to deploy the patch, but my manager told me to not it.
I wanted to deploy the patch, but my manager told me not it.
I wanted to deploy the patch, but my manager told me not to.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Our team wanted to optimize the pipeline last week, but we didn't have time to. Maria has installed the new patch, but I haven't. Will the update fail in the production environment? I hope not. For now we use the old pipeline, not the new one. If the patch works, we will switch to the new one on Friday.
What did the team want to do?
Why did the team not finish?
What does the writer hope about the update?
That it will change the pixel.
Which pipeline do they use now?
پرسش: دربارهٔ کاری که می‌خواستید انجام دهید ولی نشد بنویسید و حداقل دو ساختار آموختهشده را به کار ببرید.
Write 2-4 sentences about something you wanted to do but could not. Use at least two of: to (without verb), so/not, one/ones, neither/so.
238.m: I wanted to install the patch, but I didn't have time to. My colleague installed the old one, and so did I. Will it work? I hope so.

s: A ___ is a request for information from a database.
A ___ is a line of tasks waiting to be processed in order.
___ is malware that locks files and asks for money.
A ___ is a place where code and its history are stored.
An action that happens as it occurs, without delay, is ___.
Isolating a suspicious file so it cannot spread is called ___.
The text you give to an AI model is called a ___.
Building an early model to test an idea is called ___.

A: I can't remember the password. B: ___.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

On Monday, the development team had a meeting about a new project. The manager asked, 'Could you tell me when the prototype will be ready?' One engineer said that he did not know. She also wondered whether the proxy was working correctly. Then they talked about the pull requests. 'Nobody has reviewed them yet, have they?' she asked. Everyone agreed that they needed a better plan.
What did the manager want to know?
When the prototype will be ready
What did the engineer wonder about?
What did the team talk about next?
پرسش: یک گفتوگوی کوتاه ۴ تا ۵ خطی بین دو همکار دربارهٔ یک پروژه بنویسید. یک سؤال غیرمستقیم، یک question tag و یک پاسخ So/Neither بگنجانید.
Write a short dialogue (4-5 lines) between two colleagues about a project. Include one indirect question, one question tag and one So/Neither response.
239.m: A: Could you tell me when the prototype will be ready? B: I'm not sure. The queue is quite long, isn't it? A: Yes, it is. I haven't finished my part yet. B: Neither have I. Let's ask the manager for more time, shall we?

s: Putting together the parts of a product with robots is robotic ___.
Using robots to join metal parts is robotic ___.
The ___ decides when tasks start and stop in a computer system.
___ means a system can grow to handle more work.

A ___ helps an agile team follow the Scrum process.

There costs a lot to build a robotic arm.

Costs a lot to build a robotic arm.
متن را بخوانید و به سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید.

Last month there was a robotic expo in our city. There were many robotic startups, and it took me three hours to see all of them. One robotic arm worked with a smart sensor, and it was impressive. The scrum master of one startup said there appears to be a growing market for robotic welding. In my opinion, it is worth visiting the expo next year.
What was held in the city last month?
How long did it take the writer to see all startups?
A robotic arm working with a sensor
What does the writer think about next year's expo?

Write 3-4 sentences about a robotics or technology event or project. Use there is/are, it takes and it is worth (or it is important to).
240.m: There is a robotic competition in our city next week. It takes the teams several months to prepare their robots. There are also workshops for beginners. It is worth visiting if you are interested in robotics.

Write 3-4 formal sentences about a technical problem. Use one hedging expression, one impersonal structure and one nominalisation.
241.m: It was found that the server crashed after the update. The failure may have been caused by a security vulnerability. The slowness of the system had been reported earlier. It is therefore recommended that a full review be carried out.

Last year our team built a streaming platform for students. At first it worked well; however, we ignored technical debt, and a time overrun delayed the next release. Before the second launch, we ran a stress test and found an error in the syntax of one script. Every log has a timestamp, so we located the problem quickly. An error in the syntax of a script

Students can watch lessons without delays
پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک مشکل در یک پروژه بنویسید. یک نقطهویرگول، یک دونقطه و یک واژهٔ ارجاعی مانند this یا it را درست به کار ببرید.
Write 3-4 sentences about a problem in a project. Use one semicolon, one colon, and one reference word such as this or it correctly.
242.m: Our app had one major problem: it was too slow. We ran a stress test; the results showed a heavy delay in the database. This problem cost us two weeks, but we fixed it in the end.

Last year our team built a new app. We have been testing the user interface since March, and the first round of usability testing showed that people were confused by the menu. Because we had kept every earlier version in version control, we could return to a simpler design quickly. Next month, a security expert will check the app for any vulnerability.

Write 3-4 sentences about a problem you had with an app or a website. Use the present perfect and one conditional sentence.
243.m: I have had trouble with my bank's app since the last update. The user interface changed, and I could not find the transaction fee page. If the designers had tested it with real users, they would have noticed the problem. I hope they fix it soon.

Maya was a career changer who left her job in sales and became a web designer. On her first day, she attended a short briefing and then drew a wireframe for a new website. Although the office network was wireless, it was often slow, so she used a workaround and plugged in a cable. Never had she worked so hard, but she enjoyed it.

پرسش: در ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ زمانی بنویسید که یک برنامه جواب نداد. از although یا despite، یک جملهٔ وارونه (Never، Hardly یا Not only) و یک جملهٔ cleft استفاده کنید.

244.m: Although we had prepared a detailed wireframe, the project failed. Never had we met so many problems in one week. What we lacked was a buffer day. Not only was the schedule too tight, but nobody had assessed the risks.

Daniel worked for a large company on a fixed-term contract. Last month, after an employee appraisal, his manager offered him a permanent job. 245.m: My brother made an important career decision last year. He left his fixed-term job and became a freelancer. If he had stayed, he would have felt safer, but he is happier now. He sometimes wishes he had asked for career counseling first.

Little did she know that a famous journal would soon publish her empirical study.
How did Leila feel during her doctorate?
She felt a strong desire to travel
When did she book her trip?
Both travel and research require patience
Research is a kind of holiday
That she would lose her job
That a journal would publish her study
پرسش: ۳ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ کشف یا تجرب‌های شگفتانگیز بنویسید. حداقل سه الگوی متفاوت وارونگی به کار ببرید.

A hospital team tested a brain-computer interface (BCI) connected to an API gateway. Hardly had the test begun when they found that the attack surface was larger than expected. The attack surface was bigger than expected

پرسش: موقعیتی را توصیف کنید که دو رویداد تقریباً همزمان رخ دادند و واکنشی نشان دهید. Hardly / No sooner و So / Such ... that به کار ببرید (۳ تا ۴ جمله).
Describe a time when two events happened almost together, and add a reaction. Use Hardly / No sooner and So / Such ... that (3-4 sentences).
253.m: Hardly had I opened the file when the screen went black. So sudden was the failure that I lost an hour of work. No sooner had I restarted the computer than the power came back. Such was my relief that I laughed out loud.

Only after we ran a chaos engineering test did we find the cause: a weak cache level. It is high time every team treated resilience seriously, and we have certainly learned our lesson.

By running a chaos engineering test

پرسش: ۲ تا ۴ جمله دربارهٔ یک انتشار نرمافزار ناموفق بنویسید. یک جملهٔ وارونه و یک وجه التزامی یا فعل وجهی استنباط به کار ببرید.

Within a month, a pattern emerged: she habitually dropped articles, added unnecessary prepositions after verbs such as 'discuss', and relied on long, loosely connected sentences. Had she not analysed her mistakes systematically, she might never have noticed these habits. By the exam, she had eliminated most of them, and her mark rose accordingly.

Write a short proposal recommending a study plan for a learner preparing for a C2 exam. Include a recommendation and a brief justification.
274.m: I would strongly recommend that the learner keep an error log and review it weekly. Not only does this reveal recurring weaknesses, but it also makes progress visible. It would seem that most candidates underestimate the value of proofreading, albeit it can raise a mark considerably. In addition, two timed practice papers should be completed before the exam. Taken together, these measures are likely to build both accuracy and confidence.

دیروز هوا«3» بد بود. صبح شروع به باریدن«1» کرد، و بعد شروع به برف باریدن«2» کرد. تمام روز باد«4» شدیدی می‌وزید. به‌خاطر طوفان در خانه ماندم. من یک شغل«6» جدید در یک شرکت دارم. هر روز به دفتر«7» م می‌روم تا روی یک پروژه«10» کار کنم. ظهر، یک استراحت«5» کوتاه می‌کنم تا ناهار بخورم. بعد به کار برمی‌گردم.
امروز باید یک فتوکپی«8» از مدارکم بگیرم. همسایه‌ام یک افسر پلیس (مؤنث)«9» است و هر روز خیلی سخت کار می‌کند. من دوست دارم در جای آرام کار کنم«11». امروز مدارکم را تمام می‌کنم و بعد استراحت می‌کنم.
27: Today is my sister's birthday party, and I want to look nice. First I choose«12» a pretty necklace«3» and small earrings«1» to match my dress. I also put on a silver ring«4» that was a gift from my mother. My handbag«2» is red, and it belongs«7» to my grandmother. Yesterday I booked«8» a table at a nice restaurant for the evening. My best friend agreed to bring along«9» a cake so we can celebrate«10» together and really enjoy«24» the evening.

After lunch, everyone wants to chill«11» for a while before the games start. My little cousin loves to crawl«18» around the garden and chase our cat. My uncle comes from here«15», so he knows every neighbor, and my cousins gladly come along«16» from the next town too. Before the guests arrive, we clean«13» the living room and collect«14» all the toys from the floor. My sister offers to copy«17» the guest list, and we try to do something good«19» for our neighbors by inviting them early. This year we do it better«20» than last year, and afterward my father decides it is time to drive off«21» to the market for more drinks.

In the evening, the dog devours«22» its food quickly under the table, while I finally empty the letterbox«23» that we forgot yesterday. My little brother falls«25» off his chair while laughing, and later he is so tired that he falls asleep«26» on the sofa before dessert. My mother still needs to fill out«27» a form for our next family trip, and she checks that the dress still fits«28» me perfectly. My older cousin likes to flirt«29» with the neighbor's daughter at every party we attend. Outside, a bird tries to fly«30» over the garden, and suddenly a balloon pops«6» loudly near the table. After all the excitement, my grandmother takes a short nap«5» in the armchair.

امروز جشن تولد خواهرم است و می‌خواهم زیبا به نظر برسم. اول یک گردنبند«3» قشنگ و گوشواره‌های«1» کوچک که با لباسم ست شود انتخاب می‌کنم«12». یک انگشتر«4» نقره هم که هدیه مادرم است میپوشم. کیف دستی«2» من قرمز است و تعلق دارد«7» به مادربزرگم. دیروز یک میز در یک رستوران خوب برای شب رزرو کردم«8». بهترین دوستم قول داده کیک همراه بیاورد«9» تا با هم جشن بگیریم«10» و واقعاً از شب لذت ببریم«24».

بعد از ناهار همه می‌خواهند کمی استراحت کنند«11» قبل از شروع بازی‌ها. پسرعموی کوچکم عاشق این است که در باغ بخزد«6» و گربهمان را دنبال کند. عمویم در واقع از همینجا آمده«15»، پس همه همسایه‌ها را می‌شناسد و دخترخاله‌هایم هم می‌خواهند از شهر بعدی همراه بیایند«9». قبل از آمدن مهمان‌ها باید نشیمن را تمیز کنیم«13» و اسباببازی‌ها را از روی زمین جمع کنیم«14». خواهرم می‌خواهد لیست مهمان‌ها را کپی کند«17» و ما تلاش می‌کنیم با دعوت زودتر همسایه‌ها کار خوبی کنیم«19». امسال می‌خواهیم نسبت به سال قبل بهتر انجامش دهیم«16» و بعد پدرم تصمیم می‌گیرد برای خریدن نوشیدنی بیشتر به بازار راه بیفتد«21».

عصر سگ ما زیر میز غذایش را سریع میبلعد«18». قبل از جشن بالاخره صندوق پستی را که دیروز فراموش کرده بودیم خالی می‌کنم«23». برادر کوچکم از خنده از روی صندلی می‌افتد«20» و بعد آنقدر خسته می‌شود که قبل از دسر روی مبل به خواب می‌رود«26». مادرم هنوز باید فرم سفر خانوادگی ماه بعد را پر کند«27» و مطمئن شود لباس هنوز اندازه‌ام مناسب است«28». پسرعموی بزرگم عاشق این است که در هر جشنی با دختر همسایه دلبری کند«29». بیرون پرند‌های سعی می‌کند بالای باغ پرواز کند«30»، ناگهان یک بادکنک با صدای بلند میترکد«22» و بعد از این همه هیجان مادربزرگم روی مبل یک چرت«5» کوتاه میزند.
28: This weekend we plan«21» a short trip to visit my grandparents in the countryside. Last night I packed«1» my bag and made sure to have my papers with me«2». In the morning I get«3» the car keys from my father and fetch«4» a road map from the shelf. We also need to order«18» a taxi to the station because our car is at the garage. There we will rent«27» a small car and refuel«26» it before we move«17» further into the mountains. In the evening we finally go out«5» for a walk in the fresh air.

On the road, my father lets my brother ride along«28» in the front seat for a while. When a slow truck blocks the way, he honks«7» gently and waits. At the village, we go there«6» first to see my grandmother's garden. I look up«15» the address again because I am not sure we are on the right street. My little cousin usually follows«8» me everywhere, and today he keeps pressing«9» the doorbell over and over until it rings«12». Luckily the old car still functions«19» well, nothing seems to be missing«16», and my uncle offers to lend«14» us his umbrella just in case.

My cousins have really grown up«23» since last year, and they happily join in«10» every game we play. The youngest one likes to kick«11» the ball across the yard with his father. Grandmother kisses«24» everyone on the cheek and we all shake hands«30» with the neighbors who stop by. My aunt asks me to lay«13» the plates on the table before lunch. After the meal, my father wants to photograph«20» the whole family together, and later we plant«22» a small tree in the garden. In the children's play, my nephew always likes to play the role«25» of the king, while an old clock on the wall keeps rattling«29» softly.

این آخر هفته یک سفر کوتاه برای دیدن پدربزرگ و مادربزرگم به روستا برنامهریزی می‌کنیم«21». دیشب کیفم را بستهبندی کردم«19» و مطمئن شدم که مدارکم را همراه دارم«8». صبح کلید ماشین را از پدرم می‌گیرم«3» و یک نقشه راه از قفسه می‌آورم«4». باید یک تاکسی هم تا ایستگاه سفارش بدهیم«18» چون ماشینمان در تعمیرگاه است. آنجا یک ماشین کوچک کرایه می‌کنیم«27» و قبل از اینکه به سمت کوه‌ها حرکت کنیم«17» سوختگیری می‌کنیم«26». عصر بالاخره برای قدم زدن در هوای تازه بیرون می‌رویم«5».

توی راه پدرم اجازه می‌دهد برادرم کمی جلو همراه سوار شود«28». وقتی یک کامیون کند راه را میبندد، پدرم آرام بوق میزند«9» و صبر می‌کند. در روستا اول می‌خواهیم به آنجا برویم«6»، به باغ مادربزرگ. آدرس را دوباره بررسی می‌کنم«15» چون مطمئن نیستم در خیابان درست هستیم. پسرعموی کوچکم معمولاً همهجا مرا دنبال می‌کند«1» و امروز مدام زنگ در را فشار می‌دهد«24» تا اینکه بالاخره زنگ میزند«29». خوشبختانه ماشین قدیمی هنوز خوب کار می‌کند«2»، چیزی کم نیست«16»، و عمویم پیشنهاد می‌دهد چترش را برای احتیاط به ما قرض بدهد«14».

پسرعمو‌هایم از سال قبل واقعاً بزرگ شده‌اند«7» و با خوشحالی در هر بازیای که می‌کنیم شرکت می‌کنند«10». کوچکترینشان دوست دارد با پدرش توی حیاط توپ را لگد بزند«11». مادربزرگ همه را می بوسد«12» و همه ما با همسایه‌هایی که سر میزنند دست می‌دهیم«30». عمه‌ام از من می‌خواهد قبل از ناهار بشقاب‌ها را روی میز بگذارم«13». بعد از غذا پدرم می‌خواهد از کل خانواده با هم عکس بگیرد«20» و بعد یک درخت کوچک در باغ میکاریم«22». در نمایش بچه‌ها، برادرزاده‌ام همیشه دوست دارد نقش پادشاه را بازی کند«23»، در حالی که ساعت قدیمی روی دیوار آرام تلقتلق می‌کند«25».
29: Every morning I wake up«22» early, but today I have to wake my little brother up«9» because he is still sleeping. After that, I shower«2» quickly and get ready for the day. In the kitchen, I smell«5» fresh coffee, and suddenly I sneeze«7» because of the pepper on the table. My mother asks me to sit down«3» and eat breakfast with the family. Before I leave, I tidy up«16» my room and water the flowers«10» on the balcony. My uncle, who is a responsible adult«28», likes to talk«15» with us every morning before work.

At school, our teacher likes to make a start«8» with a short story before the lesson. During class, I always take notes«26» carefully, and I also write down«25» new words in my notebook. My friend prefers to take down every word«26» the teacher says, almost like a recording. After an hour, we usually take a break«26» and drink some tea. In the lab, we try out«17» a new experiment, and I want to try out an idea«11» of my own with the extra material. The teacher asks someone to turn«19» the pages slowly, and finishing the first exercise correctly is the first step«14», even though some classmates think grammar is boring«29».

In the afternoon, I go to shop«1» for some groceries with my mother. She asks me to take along«26» a reusable bag from home. At the checkout, I take out«26» my wallet and pay, then we unpack«20» everything at home. On weekends I usually sleep in«4», and today my father decides to take an afternoon nap«26» on the sofa. In the evening, my sister likes to watch TV«23», while I prefer to craft«27» small things out of paper. My grandfather used to smoke«6» many years ago, but he was always a brave«30» man who quit for his health.

هر روز صبح زود بیدار می‌شوم«22»، اما امروز باید برادر کوچکم را بیدار می‌کردم«22» چون هنوز خواب بود. بعد از آن سریع دوش می‌گیرم«2» و برای روز آماده می‌شوم. در آشپزخانه بوی قهوه تازه را بو می‌کنم«5» و ناگهان به خاطر فلفل روی میز عطسه می‌کنم«7». مادرم از من می‌خواهد بنشینم«3» و با خانواده صبحانه بخورم. قبل از رفتن، اتاقم را مرتب می‌کنم«16» و گل‌های بالکن را آب می‌دهم«18». عمویم که یک بزرگسال«28» مسئول است، دوست دارد هر صبح قبل از کار با ما صحبت کند«15».

در مدرسه معلممان دوست دارد درس را با یک داستان کوتاه شروع کند«8». در کلاس همیشه با دقت یادداشت برمیدارم«12» و کلمات جدید را در دفترم می‌نویسم«19». دوستم ترجیح می‌دهد تقریباً هر کلمه معلم را کلمه به کلمه یادداشت کند«21»، مثل یک ضبط صدا. بعد از یک ساعت معمولاً استراحت می‌کنیم«9» و چای مینوشیم. در آزمایشگاه یک آزمایش جدید را امتحان می‌کنیم«17» و می‌خواهم با مواد اضافی ایده خودم را امتحان کنم«24». معلم از کسی می‌خواهد صفحات را آرام بچرخاند«25»، و درست حل کردن تمرین اول یعنی اولین قدم را برداشتن«14»، حتی اگر بعضی همکلاسی‌هایم گرامر را خستهکننده«29» بدانند.

بعدازظهر برای خرید کردن«1» با مادرم می‌روم. او از من می‌خواهد یک کیسه پارچ‌های از خانه همراه ببرم«10». سر صندوق کیف پولم را بیرون می‌آورم«13» و حساب می‌کنم، بعد در خانه همه چیز را باز می‌کنیم«20». آخر هفته‌ها معمولاً تا دیروقت می‌خوابم«4»، و امروز پدرم تصمیم می‌گیرد روی مبل چرت ظهر بزند«11». عصر خواهرم دوست دارد تلویزیون تماشا کند«23»، ولی من ترجیح می‌دهم چیز‌های کوچک از کاغذ کار دستی کنم«27». پدربزرگم سال‌ها پیش سیگار میکشید«6»، اما همیشه مرد شجاعی«30» بود که برای سلامتیاش ترک کرد.
30: Last weekend we tried a new Indian«26» restaurant near our house, and the food was really excellent«16». The owner is originally from Dublin, so he also cooks some traditional Irish«27» dishes. My friend brought her Japanese«28» neighbor, who is very kind«29» and always brings small gifts. The waiter was extremely cordial«8» and made us feel welcome from the first minute. The little restaurant felt cozy«9», with soft lights and comfortable«6» chairs. By the end of the evening, everyone was telling funny«25» stories about the famous«17» chef who once cooked for a king.

The old town is very calm«1» at night, with almost no traffic on the streets. Hotels there are usually cheap«2», and the small hostel we found was even more favorable«3» in price. Our room had a double«14» bed and a window that looked out over the dark«11» rooftops of the eastern«15» part of the city. The train station is not far away«19», and we can take a direct«13» train without changing lines. My favorite«20» thing about this city is the old market by the river. Best of all, the walking tour of the historical center is completely free of charge«24».

The market stalls are full of colored«4» scarves and colorful«5» paper lanterns. My cousin thinks the roller coaster nearby looks cool«7», but our mother says it also looks a little dangerous«10». The guide is very diligent«12» and always explains every detail carefully. My little brother is usually brave, but near big dogs he suddenly becomes quite cowardly«21». Near the coast, the water is very shallow«22», so children can play safely there. Everything here feels foreign«23» to me, yet the whole trip has been simply fantastic«18» and surprisingly easy«30» to plan.

آخر هفته پیش یک رستوران هندی«26» جدید نزدیک خانهمان امتحان کردیم و غذا واقعاً عالی«16» بود. صاحب رستوران اصالتاً از دوبلین است، پس چند غذای سنتی ایرلندی«27» هم میپزد. دوستم همسایه ژاپنیاش«28» را آورد که خیلی مهربان«29» است و همیشه هدیه‌های کوچک می‌آورد. پیشخدمت خیلی صمیمانه«8» بود و از همان دقیقه اول حس خوبی به ما داد. رستوران کوچک با نور ملایم و صندلی‌های راحت«6» بسیار دنج«9» به نظر می‌رسید. آخر شب همه داستان‌های خندهدار«25» درباره سرآشپز مشهوری«17» که یک بار برای یک پادشاه آشپزی کرده بود، تعریف می‌کردند.

شهر قدیمی شب‌ها بسیار آرام«1» است و در خیابان‌ها تقریباً هیچ ترافیکی نیست. هتل‌های آنجا معمولاً ارزان«2» هستند، و هاستل کوچکی که پیدا کردیم از نظر قیمت حتی مساعدتر«3» هم بود. اتاق ما یک تخت دوبرابر«14» و پنجر‌های داشت که به پشتبام‌های تاریک«11» بخش شرقی«15» شهر باز می‌شد. ایستگاه قطار دور«19» نیست و می‌توانیم با یک قطار مستقیم«13» بدون تغییر مسیر برویم. چیز محبوب«20» من در این شهر بازار قدیمی کنار رودخانه است. بهترین قسمت این است که تور پیاده مرکز تاریخی کاملاً رایگان«24» است.

غرفه‌های بازار پر از شال‌های رنگی«4» و فانوس‌های کاغذی رنگارنگ«5» است. پسرعمویم ترن هوایی نزدیک را باحال«7» میداند، اما مادرم می‌گوید کمی هم خطرناک«10» به نظر می‌رسد. راهنمای تور خیلی ساعی«12» است و همیشه هر جزئیاتی را با دقت توضیح می‌دهد. برادر کوچکم معمولاً شجاع است، اما نزدیک سگ‌های بزرگ ناگهان کمی ترسو«21» می‌شود. نزدیک ساحل، آب خیلی کمعمق«22» است، پس بچه‌ها می‌توانند با امنیت بازی کنند. همهچیز اینجا برایم غریب«23» به نظر می‌رسد، اما کل سفر واقعاً فوقالعاده«18» و بهطور عجیبی برنامهریزیاش آسان«30» بود.
31: Our neighbor can be quite mean«1» to the children sometimes, which makes everyone uncomfortable. My best friend is very punctual«11» and always arrives exactly on time for our meetings. She is also incredibly smart«16», and her homework is usually already finished«12» before anyone else even starts. After the long walk, we were very thirsty«20», so we stopped for some water. Sometimes my brother seems sour«17» for no clear reason, but he never tells us his secret«14» worries. He has his own«8» room now, which he keeps looking perfect«9» and pretty«10» with fresh flowers every week.

Our new apartment is in the middle«2» of the city, close to everything we need. It has a mobile«3» phone signal booster because the old building blocks reception. The kitchen looks very modern«4», with clean lines and natural«5» light from a big window. It feels completely normal«6» to us now, even though the building is in the northern«7» part of town. There is a round«13» table by the window, perfect for individual«15» study sessions in the evening. The walls are quite thick«19», and the hallway is unusually wide«24» for such an old building.

At the market, we bought some very tasty«18» cheese from a small stall. The street leading there is quite narrow«21», so cars must drive slowly. We also found a used«22» bicycle in great condition for a good price. It took a whole«23» afternoon to look at everything in the market. The seller explained the basic«25» rules of the sale in a clear«26» way, without confusing us. The negotiation felt deep«27» and even a bit difficult«28» at times, but the final deal was truly great«29», even if some paperwork was still incomplete«30».

همسایهمان گاهی با بچه‌ها کمی پست«1» رفتار می‌کند و همه را ناراحت می‌کند. بهترین دوستم خیلی وقتشناس«11» است و همیشه دقیقاً بهموقع به قرار‌هایمان می‌رسد. او هم خیلی باهوش«16» است و تکالیفش معمولاً قبل از هرکس دیگری آماده«12» است. بعد از پیادهروی طولانی خیلی تشنه«20» شدیم، پس برای آب توقف کردیم. گاهی برادرم بدون دلیل واضحی عصبانی«17» به نظر می‌رسد، اما هیچوقت نگرانی‌های مخفیان‌هاش«14» را به ما نمی‌گوید. او الان اتاق خودش«8» را دارد که هر هفته با گل‌های تازه آن را بینقص«9» و زیبا«10» نگه می‌دارد.

آپارتمان جدید ما در قسمت میانی«2» شهر است، نزدیک همه چیزی که نیاز داریم. یک تقویتکننده سیگنال سیار«3» دارد، چون ساختمان قدیمی آنتن را مسدود می‌کند. آشپزخانه بسیار مدرن«4» به نظر می‌رسد، با خطوط تمیز و نور طبیعی«5» از یک پنجره بزرگ. الان برایمان کاملاً عادی«6» به نظر می‌رسد، با اینکه ساختمان در بخش شمالی«7» شهر است. کنار پنجره یک میز گرد«13» هست، مناسب برای مطالعه‌های انفرادی«15» عصرگاهی. دیوار‌ها نسبتاً ضخیم«19» هستند و راهرو برای چنین ساختمان قدیمی بهطور غیرمعمولی پهن«24» است.

نویسنده«1» مورد علاقهمان امروز به پردیس«3» آمد تا سخنرانی کند. از دیر آمدن«2» میترسیدم، پس به سمت سالن دویدم. بعد از سخنرانی، همه یک گواهینامه«4» کوچک گرفتند. معلم به ما یادآوری کرد: » تقلب ممنوع«5» « در هر امتحان. بعد به کلاس«6» رفتیم، و معلم برنامهٔ درسی«7» جدید را نشانمان داد. فردا امتحان کلاسی«8» داریم، پس باید امشب مطالعه کنیم. کلاس درس«9» مورد علاقه‌ام آن است که کنار کتابخانه است، و راستش آن کلاسدرس«9» مورد علاقه‌ام در کل ساختمان است.

در طول سخنرانی گفتم » لطفاً دوباره تکرار می‌کنید؟«11» « چون جمله آخر را از دست دادم. یک دقیقه بعد، دانشجوی دیگری هم پرسید » دوباره تکرار می‌کنید؟«12» « یکی دیگر گفت » می‌توانید آهسته صحبت کنید؟«13» « چون موضوع سخت بود. این دوره«14» سختتر از چیزی است که انتظار داشتم. خواهرم در یک مهدکودک«15» نزدیک خانهمان کار می‌کند. معلممان برای مقاله یک مهلت نهایی«16» به ما داد. تحویل«17» پروژه نهاییمان هفته آینده است. بخش«18» ما یک رویداد جدید برای دانشجویان برنامهریزی می‌کند. دیروز یک مدرک«19» مهم را از کیفم گم کردم. در پایان کلاس، معلم پرسید » کسی سؤالی دارد؟«20» «

43: Today is the first day of the new semester«21» at the university. I finished my registration«14» yesterday, and the secretary«20» in the office checked my papers and asked for my signature«22». امروز اولین روز ترم«21» جدید در دانشگاه است. من دیروز ثبتنامم«14» را تمام کردم و منشی«20» دفتر مدارکم را بررسی کرد و امضایم«22» را خواست. پسرخالهی کوچکم تازه به مهدکودک«3» رفته، با اینکه بیشتر بچه‌ها کمی دیرتر به سن مهدکودک«4» می‌رسند. هنوز روز‌هایی را که یک دانشجوی«23» جوان بودم به یاد دارم. قبل از شروع کلاس، استاد لبخند زد و گفت: » کلاس را شروع کنیم.«6» « او فهرست حضور و غیاب«18» را نگاه کرد و ما را به درس آینده«10» ترم خوشآمد گفت.

بعد از یک کلاس طولانی در دانشگاه«3»، استادمان تصمیم گرفت استراحت کند«1». من فراموش کردم در بحث دربارهی نمرات یادداشت بردارم«2»، پس از یک همکلاسی پرسیدم: » نمرات اعلام شد؟«4» « او گفت نه و از دوست دیگری پرسید: » استاد چی گفت؟«5» « دربارهی امتحان بعدی. وقتی او قانون جدید را توضیح داد، اخم کردم و گفتم: » یعنی چطور؟«6» « او سادهترش کرد، اما باز پرسیدم: » یعنی چه؟«7» « در راه خانه صدای آمبولانس«8» را شنیدم و یک ماشین پلیس«10» نزدیک یک تصادف کوچک دیدم، در حالی که آتشنشانی«9» بهسرعت رسید تا آتش را خاموش کند«11» در یک مغازهی نزدیک.

هر احساسی«14» که داریم روز ما را شکل می‌دهد، و امروز احساس من پر از خوشحالی«15» است. وقتی دوست قدیمیام را دوباره دیدم، شادی«19» خالص قلبم را پر کرد و نتوانستم لبخندم«20» را پنهان کنم. واقعاً می‌توانستم احساس کنم«24» چقدر خوشحالم. خوشحال شدن«21» از چیز‌های کوچک آسان است، مثل هوای آفتابی یا آهنگی که واقعاً خوشم می‌آید«15». در عمق قلبم همیشه کمی امید«17» وجود دارد، و من امیدوارم«26» همه چیز برای کسانی که دوستشان دارم خوب پیش برود.

گاهی بدشانسی«13» می‌آوریم، و وقتی چیز‌ها طبق برنامه پیش نمی‌روند واقعاً حیف«12» است. وقتی کسی خبر ناراحتکنند‌های می‌گوید، همیشه برایش متأسف می‌شوم«23». هرکسی هر روز خوششانس«22» نیست. تلاش می‌کنم هیچوقت از کسی متنفر نشوم«25»، هرچند برای یک لحظه بعد از خبر بد نفرت«16» واقعی حس کردم. بعد از یک غذای بزرگ دیگر گرسنگی«18» ندارم. در مدرسه همیشه زباله«28» را در سطل زباله«29» درست می‌ریزیم، و همه باید صرفهجویی انرژی«30» را در خانه یاد بگیرند.

هر عضو خانواده«14» در دیدار خانوادگی«16» نقشی دارد، بهخصوص وقتی بچه‌ها هم هستند. دخترخاله‌ام سال پیش طلاق گرفت«13»، اما هنوز از گذراندن وقت با اعضای خانواده«15» ما لذت می‌برد. او اغلب می‌گوید یک روز دوباره تمایل به فرزند«12» قویای حس می‌کند. وقتی خواهرم تصمیم گرفت با دوستش ازدواج کند«20»، شروع کردیم به خرید وسایل نوزاد«11» مثل لباس و یک کالسکه کودک«19» جدید. عمویم قبول کرد پدرخوانده«17» نوزاد بشود، و همه دربارهی تعداد فرزندان«18» دقیقی که زوج جوان برنامه داشتند پرسیدند.
